items.title: EASL-EASD-EASO Guidance for the Use of Resmetirom and Semaglutide as MASH-Targeted Therapy.
items.abstract: Adults with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and steatohepatitis (MASH) are at risk for cardiometabolic complications and major adverse liver-related outcomes (MALO), including cirrhosis, cancer, and liver transplantation. Non-invasive tests (NIT) for hepatic fibrosis, including vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE), magnetic resonance elastography (MRE), or enhanced liver fibrosis (ELF) score, can replace liver biopsy to identify high risk for MALO (e.g. VCTE 10-20 kPa, MRE 3.1-5.0 kPa, or ELF 9.8-11.3), in which pharmacotherapy may be considered. Following approval by regulatory agencies, this joint EASL-EASD-EASO guidance provides updated recommendations for the use of resmetirom (80mg/100mg po) and semaglutide (2.4 mg sc weekly) in MASH, covering treatment candidate selection, treatment initiation, monitoring, and discontinuation. Pharmacotherapy is recommended for adults with non-cirrhotic MASH and fibrosis stages 2-3 (based on NITs or biopsy), alongside structured lifestyle intervention and optimized comorbidity management. Therapy selection should be individualized according to preferences, potential risks, and cardio-renal-metabolic profile, including presence of obesity, type 2 diabetes (T2D), cardiovascular, and chronic kidney disease. Semaglutide, a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA), may be preferred in adults with obesity or T2D as well as with established cardiovascular (CV) disease or high CV risk because of its cardiometabolic benefits, whereas resmetirom may be prioritized in individuals without obesity or those already receiving or intolerant to GLP-1RAs. Additional recommendations include structured safety and efficacy monitoring such as nutritional and sarcopenia assessment during semaglutide or use of fibrosis NITs for longitudinal response criteria. Ongoing studies are evaluating long-term effectiveness of both agents to reduce MALO. In adults with MASH cirrhosis, resmetirom or semaglutide appear safe but should not be used as MASH-targeted treatment, until further data establish liver-related benefits.
items.summary_ja: EASL-EASD-EASOが共同で発表した、MASH（メタボリック機能異常関連脂肪性肝炎）を対象としたresmetirom（80mg/100mg 経口）とsemaglutide（2.4mg 週1回皮下注射）の使用に関するガイダンス。治療対象者の選定、治療開始、モニタリング、中止基準をカバーし、非肝硬変性MASHかつ線維化ステージ2-3の成人に対して、構造化された生活習慣介入および合併症管理と併せて薬物療法を推奨する。治療選択は肥満、2型糖尿病、心血管疾患、慢性腎臓病の有無など個々の心・腎・代謝プロファイルに基づき個別化すべきとされている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 非肝硬変性MASHかつ線維化ステージ2-3の成人では、resmetiromまたはsemaglutideによる薬物療法が推奨される。semaglutideは肥満・2型糖尿病・心血管疾患を有する患者に、resmetiromは肥満を有しない患者やGLP-1RA不耐容・使用中の患者に優先的に考慮される。MASH肝硬変では安全性は示唆されるが、肝関連の利益が確立されるまでMASH標的治療としては使用すべきでない。
items.why_matters_ja: MASLD/MASHを有する成人は心血管代謝合併症や重大な肝関連アウトカム（MALO：肝硬変、肝がん、肝移植）のリスクが高く、規制当局の承認後に初めてこれら2剤の使用に関する統合的な臨床ガイダンスが提示されたことで、実臨床における治療意思決定の根拠となる。
items.study_type_ja: プラクティスガイドライン（EASL-EASD-EASO共同ガイダンス）
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に明示的な臨床試験のエンドポイント定義は記載されていない。MALO（肝硬変、肝がん、肝移植）が主要な肝関連アウトカムとして言及され、線維化NIT（VCTE、MRE、ELF）による縦断的応答評価が推奨事項として述べられている。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Efficacy of Subcutaneous Semaglutide Dose Escalation in Reducing Insulin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a chronic disease that affects nearly 25% of patients in the US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health care system. Semaglutide 2 mg has been found to significantly improve hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) when compared with semaglutide 1 mg in patients who are not taking insulin. The purpose of this study was to investigate the effect subcutaneous semaglutide dose escalation has on total daily insulin dose in patients with T2DM.
METHODS: This retrospective, single-center chart review study was conducted at the VA Sioux Falls Health Care System. The primary endpoint was change in daily insulin dose from baseline to semaglutide dose increase after receiving semaglutide 2 mg for ≥ 3 months. Baseline was defined as initiation of semaglutide 0.5 mg. Secondary endpoints included changes in daily bolus or basal insulin doses, HbA1c level, and number of hypoglycemic events reported.
RESULTS: Sixty-two patients were included. Daily insulin dose changed -5.6% (95% CI, 2.2-14.0; P = .008) from baseline to 1-mg dose initiation, -22.2% (95% CI, 22.0-35.1; P < .001) at 2-mg dose initiation, and -36.9% (95% CI, 37.4-56.5; P < .001) after ≥ 3 months at the 2-mg dose. Mean HbA1c level decreased from 7.7% at baseline to 7.1% at 2-mg dose initiation (95% CI, 0.3-0.8; P < .001).
CONCLUSIONS: There were statistically significant reductions in total daily insulin dose when subcutaneous semaglutide was initiated and further reduction with each semaglutide dose increase. These results support the current practice of prescribing semaglutide to treat T2DM and suggest that when the dose is increased to 2 mg, patients may experience reductions in total daily insulin dose and HbA1c levels.
items.journal: Federal practitioner : for the health care professionals of the VA, DoD, and PHS
items.authors: Halver Alisha, Wiksen John, Larson Aaron, Wegner Amber
items.summary_ja: VA Sioux Falls Health Care Systemにおいて実施された後ろ向き単一施設カルテレビュー研究。2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者における皮下注射セマグルチドの増量（0.5 mg→1 mg→2 mg）が総日量インスリン用量に与える影響を調査した。主要エンドポイントは、セマグルチド2 mgを3か月以上使用後のインスリン日量の変化（ベースラインはセマグルチド0.5 mg開始時）であり、二次エンドポイントはボルス/ベースアルインスリン日量の変化、HbA1c値、低血糖事象の報告数であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 皮下注射セマグルチドの増量に伴い、総日量インスリン用量が統計的に有意に減少した（1 mg開始時 -5.6%、2 mg開始時 -22.2%、2 mg 3か月以上継続時 -36.9%）。また、HbA1cはベースライン7.7%から2 mg開始時7.1%へ低下した。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチドの2 mgへの増量により総日量インスリン用量およびHbA1c値の低下が期待できることを示し、T2DMに対するセマグルチド処方の現行プラクティスを支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き単一施設カルテレビュー研究
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：セマグルチド2 mgを3か月以上使用後のインスリン日量の変化（ベースライン＝セマグルチド0.5 mg開始時）。二次エンドポイント：ボルス/ベースアルインスリン日量の変化、HbA1c値、低血糖事象の報告数。

items.title: Oral Health-Related Adverse Events of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: As the clinical use of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) continues to grow for the management of type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular and renal protection, noncirrhotic fatty liver disease, and weight management, their potential implications for oral health need to be considered.
OBJECTIVES: This study examined oral health-related adverse events (AEs) associated with GLP-1 RAs using postmarketing data from the US Food and Drug Administration Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS).
METHODS: FAERS reports for available GLP-1 RAs, exenatide, liraglutide, semaglutide, dulaglutide, and tirzepatide, were screened from their initial market introduction through December 2025, identifying 364,274 total AE reports, of which 31,195 (8.6%) involved oral, craniofacial, or dental manifestations.
RESULTS: Tirzepatide, despite being one of the most recently approved GLP-1 RAs, accounted for the highest overall AE volume, and semaglutide demonstrated the largest proportion of oral health-related AEs. A disproportionality analysis revealed a significant drug-specific signal for dry mouth of semaglutide, while vomiting, regurgitation, and reflux-related events produced a significant signal across all 5 drugs. Sensory disorders, including dysgeusia and taste disturbances, also demonstrated significant proportional reporting ratios (PRRs) and reporting odds ratios (RORs) for several GLP-1 RAs. Association analysis of AEs showed significant associations between vomiting and taste disturbances, as well as between dry mouth and dysgeusia, particularly with semaglutide and dulaglutide.
CONCLUSION: This analysis highlights emerging safety signals in oral health and underscores the need for heightened clinical awareness and prospective studies to characterize the incidence, timing, and mechanisms of oral AEs associated with GLP-1 RA therapy.Knowledge Transfer Statement:Understanding the oral adverse effects associated with GLP-1 receptor agonists allows clinicians and dental providers to more effectively counsel patients initiating or continuing these medications. By recognizing early symptoms such as dry mouth, dysgeusia, and reflux-related irritation, providers can implement targeted preventive strategies-including hydration guidance, salivary substitutes, dietary modifications, and closer oral health monitoring-to reduce complications and improve patient comfort, adherence, and overall treatment outcomes. This knowledge enhances interdisciplinary management of individuals using GLP-1 RAs.
items.authors: Massarotto F C, Mahmoud A H, Watson G E, Arany S
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体アゴニスト（exenatide, liraglutide, semaglutide, dulaglutide, tirzepatide）の口腔健康関連有害事象（AE）を、米国FDAのFAERS（Adverse Event Reporting System）のpostmarketingデータを用いて解析した薬物警戒研究である。各薬剤の市場導入から2025年12月までのFAERS報告をスクリーニングし、総AE報告364,274件中31,195件（8.6%）が口腔・頭頸部・歯科関連の発現を伴っていた。不均衡分析（disproportionality analysis）により、semaglutideの口渇に薬剤特異的なシグナルが認められ、嘔吐・逆流・reflux関連事象は全5薬剤で有意なシグナルを示した。味覚障害・dysgeusiaを含む感覚障害も複数のGLP-1 RAで有意なPRRおよびRORを示した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: FAERS postmarketingデータ解析により、GLP-1 RAに口腔健康関連AEの有意なシグナルが検出された。特にsemaglutideの口渇、全5薬剤共通の嘔吐・reflux関連事象、および複数の薬剤における味覚障害が主要なシグナルとして示された。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1 RAの適応が2型糖尿病から心血管・腎保護、非肝硬変性脂肪肝疾患、体重管理へと拡大する中、口腔健康への影響を認識することは、患者への適切なカウンセリング、予防的介入（水分補給指導、唾液代替剤、食事修正、口腔健康モニタリングの強化）の実施、および学際的マネジメントの向上に不可欠である。
items.study_type_ja: 薬物警戒研究（postmarketing safety signal detection study）／FAERSデータベースを用いた不均衡分析（disproportionality analysis）
items.endpoints_ja: 口腔健康関連有害事象（AE）：口渇、嘔吐、逆流（regurgitation）、reflux関連事象、感覚障害（dysgeusia、味覚障害）。解析手法は不均衡分析（PRR、ROR）およびAE間の関連分析。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 総AE報告364,274件中、口腔・頭頸部・歯科関連発現を伴うものは31,195件（8.6%）。Tirzepatideが最も高い総AE量を示し、semaglutideが口腔健康関連AEの最大割合を示した。Semaglutideの口渇に薬剤特異的な有意シグナル。嘔吐・regurgitation・reflux関連事象は全5薬剤で有意シグナル。感覚障害（dysgeusia、味覚障害）は複数のGLP-1 RAで有意なPRRおよびROR。嘔吐と味覚障害の間、口渇とdysgeusiaの間に有意な関連が認められ、特にsemaglutideとdulaglutideで顕著。

items.title: Efficacy and Safety of CagriSema in Type 2 Diabetes: A Dose- and Comparator-Specific Systematic Review and Bayesian Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: CagriSema combines cagrilintide with semaglutide and may improve glycaemic control and body weight in Type 2 diabetes. We evaluated its dose- and comparator-specific efficacy and safety.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, CENTRAL and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched through 30 June 2026 for randomized controlled trials. Analyses were stratified by CagriSema dose and comparator. For HbA1c and body weight, efficacy/trial-product estimands were aligned where sufficiently reported, with treatment-policy estimates examined in sensitivity analyses. Bayesian random-effects models generated posterior medians and 95% credible intervals (CrIs).
RESULTS: Six trials representing 4554 potentially eligible participants with Type 2 diabetes were included. Compared with placebo, CagriSema 2.4 mg produced between-group differences of -1.87 percentage points in HbA1c (95% CrI, -2.08 to -1.62) and -12.69 percentage points in percentage body-weight change (95% CrI, -13.78 to -11.61). Versus semaglutide 2.4 mg, the additional HbA1c reduction was modest and uncertain (-0.21 percentage points; 95% CrI, -0.62 to 0.11), whereas additional body-weight reduction remained probable (-5.84 percentage points; 95% CrI, -10.08 to -2.15). Gastrointestinal adverse events and adverse-event-related discontinuation were increased versus placebo (RR, 2.27 [95% CrI, 1.81 - 3.00] and 3.16 [1.50 to 6.87], respectively), while estimates versus semaglutide were less precise.
CONCLUSIONS: CagriSema provides substantial glycaemic and body-weight benefits versus placebo. Its incremental advantage over dose-matched semaglutide is more evident for body-weight reduction, while comparative gastrointestinal tolerability and discontinuation risk remain uncertain.
items.authors: Kow Chia Siang, Zaihan Abdullah Faiz, Ramachandram Dinesh Sangarran, Thiruchelvam Kaeshaelya
items.summary_ja: CagriSema（カグリリンチド＋セマグルチド）の2型糖尿病における用量・比較薬別有効性及び安全性を評価した系統的レビューおよびベイズメタ解析。PubMed、Embase、CENTRAL、ClinicalTrials.govから2026年6月30日までにランダム化比較試験を検索し、6試験・4554名の対象参加者を含む。ベイズランダムエフェクトモデルを用いて後続中央値および95%信頼区間（CrI）を算出した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CagriSemaはプラセボ対照で血糖コントロールおよび体重減少に大きな効果を示した。用量一致のセマグルチド2.4 mgとの比較では、体重減少における増分効果はより明確である一方、HbA1cの増分効果は不確実であり、消化管耐性及び中止リスクの比較も不確実であった。
items.why_matters_ja: CagriSemaはカグリリンチドとセマグルチドを組み合わせ、2型糖尿病の血糖コントロールおよび体重改善に寄与しうる。用量・比較薬別の有効性・安全性の明確化は、臨床現場での治療選択に重要なエビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビューおよびベイズメタ解析（ランダム化比較試験を対象）
items.endpoints_ja: HbA1c、体重変化率（percentage body-weight change）、消化管有害事象、有害事象関連中止
items.endpoint_results_ja: プラセボ対照（CagriSema 2.4 mg）：HbA1c群間差 -1.87ポイント（95% CrI, -2.08〜-1.62）、体重変化率 -12.69ポイント（95% CrI, -13.78〜-11.61）。セマグルチド2.4 mg対照：HbA1c群間差 -0.21ポイント（95% CrI, -0.62〜0.11）、体重変化率 -5.84ポイント（95% CrI, -10.08〜-2.15）。消化管有害事象（プラセボ対照）：RR 2.27（95% CrI, 1.81〜3.00）。有害事象関連中止（プラセボ対照）：RR 3.16（95% CrI, 1.50〜6.87）。

items.title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist use and risk of postmastectomy lymphedema in breast cancer survivors: a multicenter real-world cohort study.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: Postmastectomy lymphedema is a chronic survivorship complication after breast cancer treatment, particularly among patients exposed to axillary surgery. Obesity and metabolic inflammation are recognized contributors to lymphedema risk. This study evaluated whether glucagon-like peptide - 1 receptor agonist exposure was associated with lower incidence of coded postmastectomy lymphedema among breast cancer patients with mastectomy and/or axillary procedure exposure.
METHODS: We performed a retrospective cohort study using deidentified electronic health record data from the TriNetX Research Network. Adult patients with breast cancer and coded mastectomy and/or axillary procedural exposure were stratified by GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure versus no exposure. One-to-one propensity score matching was used to balance measured baseline characteristics. The primary outcome was incident coded postmastectomy lymphedema syndrome. Outcomes were assessed from 1 to 650 days after the index event using risk estimates, Kaplan-Meier analysis, and Cox proportional hazards models.
RESULTS: After propensity score matching, 61,630 patients were included, with 30,815 patients in each cohort. Coded postmastectomy lymphedema occurred in 258 of 29,259 GLP-1 receptor agonist users and 779 of 30,237 non-users, corresponding to incidence rates of 0.88% and 2.58%, respectively. GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure was associated with lower incidence of coded postmastectomy lymphedema in time-to-event analysis (hazard ratio 0.373, 95% CI 0.324-0.429; p < 0.001). The absolute risk difference was - 1.7%, with an estimated number needed to treat of 59.
CONCLUSION: In this large real-world breast cancer surgical/procedural cohort, GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure was associated with lower incidence of coded postmastectomy lymphedema over 650 days of follow-up. These findings are hypothesis-generating and require prospective validation with systematic lymphedema assessment and detailed characterization of GLP-1 receptor agonist timing, duration, dose, and adherence.
items.journal: Supportive care in cancer : official journal of the Multinational Association of Supportive Care in Cancer
items.authors: Yesho Dawit Hailemariam, Megiso Muluken Zeleke, Ugwu Chidiebube, Neely Ariana N, Verinumbe Tarfa, Varadi Gabor, Jones Colton
items.summary_ja: TriNetX研究ネットワークの非識別化電子カルテデータを用いた多施設後方視コホート研究。乳癌で乳輪切術および/または腋窩手術のコード化曝露を受けた成人患者を、GLP-1受容体作動薬曝露群と非曝露群に分類し、1対1の傾向スコアマッチングによりベースライン特性を均衡させた。主評価項目はコード化された術後リンパ浮腫症候群の新規発生であり、インデックスイベント後1〜650日間でリスク推定、Kaplan-Meier解析、Cox比例ハザードモデルにより評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬曝露は、コード化された術後リンパ浮腫の発生率低下と関連した（ハザード比0.373、95%CI 0.324-0.429、p<0.001）。ただし著者は本結果を仮説生成性とし、系統的リンパ浮腫評価を伴う前向き検証が必要と述べている。
items.why_matters_ja: 術後リンパ浮腫は乳癌治療後の慢性サバイバーシップ合併症であり、特に腋窩手術曝露患者に多い。GLP-1受容体作動薬がリンパ浮腫リスクを低減する可能性が示唆されれば、広範に使用されている薬剤の二次的有益性として臨床的に重要である。ただし本研究はコード化データに基づく後方視研究であり、仮説生成性である。
items.study_type_ja: 多施設後方視コホート研究（実世界データ）
items.endpoints_ja: 主評価項目：コード化された術後リンパ浮腫症候群の新規発生（インデックスイベント後1〜650日間）
items.sample_size_ja: 傾向スコアマッチング後61,630例（各コホート30,815例）

items.title: Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists in Heart Transplant Recipients With Type 2 Diabetes: A Multicenter Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is frequent after heart transplantation (HT) and is exacerbated by immunosuppressive therapy. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) may improve metabolic control, but data in HT recipients are limited.
METHODS: We performed a retrospective, multicenter study including HT recipients with T2DM from 14 Spanish centers. In patients treated with GLP-1 RAs, we assessed antidiabetic and immunosuppressive therapies, adverse events, and changes in metabolic parameters, insulin dose, and immunosuppressant trough levels during the first year after GLP-1 RA initiation.
RESULTS: Among 734 HT recipients with T2DM (2011-2021), 108 (14.7%) received GLP-1 RAs (mean age 55.4 ± 9.0 y; 79.6% male), initiated 4.0 ± 3.1 y post-HT. At baseline, 64.8% had obesity. Semaglutide was used in 59%, dulaglutide in 27%, liraglutide in 13%, and tirzepatide in 1%; 41.7% achieved the maximum therapeutic dose. After 1 y, significant reductions were observed in body weight (-6.2 kg; 95% confidence interval [CI], -7.7 to -4.5 kg), fasting glucose (-27 mg/dL; 95% CI, -41 to -7 mg/dL), glycated hemoglobin (-0.74%; 95% CI, -1.12% to -0.35%), total cholesterol (-12 mg/dL; 95% CI, -19 to -6 mg/dL), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (-8 mg/dL; 95% CI, -14 to -2 mg/dL), triglycerides (-29 mg/dL; 95% CI, -53 to -5 mg/dL), and systolic blood pressure (-3.6 mm Hg; 95% CI, -6.4 to -0.9 mm Hg). Tacrolimus trough levels decreased modestly (-0.7 ng/mL; 95% CI, -1.4 to -0.1 ng/mL; P = 0.025), without episodes of acute rejection. Gastrointestinal adverse events occurred in 12.0%, leading to discontinuation in 3.7%.
CONCLUSIONS: In HT recipients with T2DM, GLP-1 RAs were associated with improved glycemic and cardiometabolic parameters and were generally well tolerated. These findings support the use of GLP-1 RAs as a valuable therapeutic strategy for the management of T2DM after HT.
items.authors: Blazquez-Bermejo Zorba, Enríquez-Vázquez Daniel, García-Romero Elena, Mitroi Cristina, Severo Andrea, Esteve Ruiz Iris María, Castel María Angeles, Martínez Solé Julia
items.summary_ja: スペインの14施設から心臓移植（HT）受容者かつ2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者を対象とした後ろ向き多施設研究。2011〜2021年のHT受容者T2DM患者734例中、108例（14.7%）がGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）を投与されていた。GLP-1 RA開始後1年間の抗糖尿病薬・免疫抑制薬、有害事象、代謝パラメータ、インスリン用量、免疫抑制薬の谷濃度の変化を評価した。1年後、体重（-6.2 kg）、空腹時血糖（-27 mg/dL）、HbA1c（-0.74%）、総コレステロール（-12 mg/dL）、LDL-C（-8 mg/dL）、トリグリセリド（-29 mg/dL）、収縮期血圧（-3.6 mm Hg）に有意な低下が認められた。タクロリムス谷濃度は軽度低下（-0.7 ng/mL）したが、急性拒絶反応は認められなかった。消化管有害事象は12.0%、中止は3.7%であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: HT受容者T2DM患者において、GLP-1 RAは血糖値および心代謝パラメータの改善と関連し、全体的に良好な忍容性を示した。
items.why_matters_ja: T2DMはHT後に頻発し、免疫抑制療法により悪化することが知られているが、HT受容者におけるGLP-1 RAのデータは限られていた。本研究は、HT後のT2DM管理においてGLP-1 RAが有効な治療戦略であることを支持するエビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き多施設観察研究
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、空腹時血糖、HbA1c、総コレステロール、LDL-C、トリグリセリド、収縮期血圧、タクロリムス谷濃度、急性拒絶反応、有害事象（消化管）、中止率
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし
items.sample_size_ja: HT受容者T2DM患者734例（2011〜2021年）、うちGLP-1 RA投与群108例（14.7%）

items.title: A Comparative Outcome Review of Abdominoplasty Following Massive Weight Loss.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Abdominoplasty after massive weight loss has higher complication rates than for other reasons. It is unclear if outcomes vary by method of weight loss, especially with increasing use of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists.
METHODS: One hundred seventy-six patients had abdominoplasty after massive weight loss by a single surgeon. The main comparison was bariatric procedures (gastric sleeve, bypass, banding; n=118) versus diet and exercise (n=47). Complications were re-examined and reclassified. Logistic regression adjusted for BMI, resection weight, and diabetes.
RESULTS: Thirty-one patients (17.6%) experienced major complications (readmission or return to theatre). major complications were more common after bariatric than diet and exercise weight loss (22.0% vs. 8.5%; OR 3.04, p=0.046). Gastric bypass had the highest risk (39.1%; OR 6.91, p=0.007), based on a small subgroup (n=23), and is hypothesis-generating. After adjustment for BMI, resection weight, and diabetes, the difference was not significant (adjusted OR 2.33, p=0.16). Discrimination was modest for any complication (AUC 0.550) and better for major complication (0.674).
CONCLUSIONS: Major complication rates are higher after bariatric than after diet and exercise weight loss, but this difference is largely explained by residual obesity at surgery. Body mass index was the most consistent modifiable factor. Gastric bypass patients should be counselled specifically about the elevated risk.
LEVEL OF EVIDENCE III: This journal requires that authors assign a level of evidence to each article. For a full description of these Evidence-Based Medicine ratings, please refer to the Table of Contents or the online Instructions to Authors http://www.springer.com/00266 .
items.authors: Brown Tim, Moghaddas Jason, McTaggart Jaimee, Murphy Tracey
items.summary_ja: 単一外科医による大量減量後の腹壁形成術を受けた176例を対象とした比較アウトカムレビュー。主要比較は肥満治療手術（胃スリーブ、バイパス、バンディング；n=118）と食事・運動による減量（n=47）であった。主要合併症（再入院または再手術）は肥満治療手術群で有意に高かった（22.0% vs 8.5%；OR 3.04, p=0.046）。ただしBMI、切除重量、糖尿病で調整後、差は有意ではなかった（調整後OR 2.33, p=0.16）。BMIが最も一貫した修正可能因子であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満治療手術後の腹壁形成術では食事・運動減量後に比べ主要合併症率が高いが、この差は手術時の残存肥満（BMI）によってほぼ説明される。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の増加に伴い、減量方法による術後アウトカムの違いが臨床的に重要である。BMIが最も一貫した修正可能因子であることが示され、術前リスク評価や患者説明に活用可能である。
items.study_type_ja: 単一施設・単一外科医による後向き比較コホート研究（Evidence Level III）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要合併症（再入院または再手術）

items.title: [Efficacy and safety of domestic semaglutide injection in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus inadequately controlled with metformin: a multicenter, randomized, controlled phase 3 equivalence clinical trial].
items.abstract: Objective: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of domestic semaglutide injection in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) inadequately controlled with metformin. Methods: This multicenter, randomized, positive-controlled phase 3 equivalence clinical trial enrolled patients with T2DM from 39 research centers in China between March 13, 2024, and April 9, 2025. Central randomization was performed using interactive response technology, and the subjects were stratified according to their glycated hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) levels (<8.5% and ≥8.5%) and randomly divided into an experimental group (domestic semaglutide injection) and a control group (original semaglutide injection) at a ratio of 1∶1. The primary endpoint was the change from baseline in HbA1c at week 32, with an equivalent threshold of ±0.4%. The key secondary endpoints included HbA1c change from baseline at week 20, the proportion of patients with HbA1c<7.0% or HbA1c≤6.5% at 20 and 32 weeks, and the evaluation of safety. Efficacy endpoints were analyzed in the full analysis set (FAS), and safety endpoints were analyzed in the safety set (SS). Changes from baseline in HbA1c were analyzed using a mixed model for repeated measures; the proportions of subjects with HbA1c<7.0% or HbA1c≤6.5% were compared using the Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel χ2 test; and safety endpoints were analyzed using Fisher's exact test. Results: Both the FAS and SS included 481 patients, with 241 in the experimental group and 240 in the control group. After 32 weeks of treatment, the least squares mean (LSM) (95%CI) changes from baseline in HbA1c were -1.80% (-1.93%--1.68%) in the experimental group and -1.85% (-1.98%--1.72%) in the control group, with a difference of 0.05% (-0.13%-0.23%)(both one-sided P<0.001). Similarly, equivalence was demonstrated at week 20, with an intergroup difference (95%CI) of 0.08% (-0.10%-0.26%) for the change from baseline in HbA1c (both one-sided P<0.001). The proportions of patients achieving HbA1c<7.0% or HbA1c≤6.5% showed no statistically significant differences between the two groups. The incidence of overall adverse events was comparable between the two groups [85.06% (205/241) vs 83.33% (200/240)], and the incidences of drug-related hypoglycemic events were 0.41% (1/241) and 2.50% (6/240), respectively, with no statistically significant differences (both P>0.05). Conclusions: In patients with T2DM inadequately controlled by metformin, domestic semaglutide injection demonstrated glucose-lowering efficacy equivalent to original semaglutide injection over the 32-week short-term period, with generally similar overall safety profiles between the two groups.
items.authors: Wang W M, Tong G Y, Zhao Z G, Liu Y, Chang J P, Wang C, Zhao Y Z, Liu X Y
items.summary_ja: 中国の39施設で実施された多施設ランダム化陽性対照第III相同等性試験。メトホルミンで血糖コントロール不十分な2型糖尿病患者481例（実験群241例：国産セマグルチド注射、対照群240例：先発セマグルチド注射）を1:1で割り付け、32週間のHbA1c変化（同等性閾値±0.4%）を主評価項目として評価した。32週時および20週時のHbA1c変化で同等性が示され、安全性プロファイルも両群間で類似であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: メトホルミンでコントロール不十分な2型糖尿病患者において、国産セマグルチド注射は先発セマグルチド注射と32週間の血糖降下効果で同等であり、安全性プロファイルも類似であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 中国市場において先発セマグルチド注射の国産品（同等性製品）が臨床的に同等であることを示す第III相試験であり、薬価・アクセス性への影響が期待される。
items.study_type_ja: 多施設ランダム化陽性対照第III相同等性試験
items.endpoints_ja: 主評価項目：32週時のベースラインからのHbA1c変化（同等性閾値±0.4%）。主要副次評価項目：20週時のベースラインからのHbA1c変化、20週時および32週時のHbA1c<7.0%またはHbA1c≤6.5%達成率、安全性評価。

items.title: Early Initiation of SGLT2 inhibitor and Mortality in Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction: A Target Trial Emulation Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) improve outcomes in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), yet the optimal timing of initiation in routine clinical practice remains uncertain. We investigated the impact of early initiation of SGLT2i within 30 days of HFrEF diagnosis on mortality and HF hospitalization.
METHODS: Using Danish nationwide register data from July 2020 to August 2024, adults with incident HFrEF eligible for SGLT2i therapy were identified. A target trial comparing initiation of SGLT2i within 30 days of HFrEF diagnosis versus no SGLT2i initiation during this 30-day period was emulated. The analysis used a clone-censor-weight design with follow-up starting at HFrEF diagnosis. The primary outcome was one-year all-cause mortality, and HF hospitalization was assessed as a secondary outcome.
RESULTS: Among 10,346 patients with incident HFrEF, 3268 (31.6%) initiated an SGLT2i within 30 days of HFrEF diagnosis and 7078 (68.4%) did not initiate the treatment during this 30-day window. About 226 deaths occurred among SGLT2i initiators and 637 deaths among non-initiators. Compared with non-initiation, initiation of SGLT2i within 30 days was associated with lower one-year risks of both death (RD -1.1 percentage points; 95% CI (-2.0 to -0.2)) and HF hospitalization (RD -3.4 percentage points; 95% CI (-3.9 to -2.9)).
CONCLUSIONS: Initiation of an SGLT2i within 30 days of HFrEF diagnosis was associated with lower one-year mortality and HF hospitalization compared with no initiation. These findings support prioritizing early SGLT2i initiation as part of foundational therapy for HFrEF in routine clinical practice.
items.authors: Mkoma George Frederick, Hviid Anders, Pasternak Björn, Svanström Henrik
items.summary_ja: デンマーク全国レジスターデータ（2020年7月〜2024年8月）を用いたターゲットトライアルエミュレーション研究。新規HFrEF患者10,346例を対象に、HFrEF診断後30日以内のSGLT2阻害薬開始群（3,268例、31.6%）と非開始群（7,078例、68.4%）を比較し、1年全死因死亡率（主要エンドポイント）および心不全入院（副次エンドポイント）への影響を評価した。clone-censor-weight設計を用い、追跡開始はHFrEF診断時とした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: HFrEF診断後30日以内のSGLT2阻害薬開始は、非開始と比較して1年全死因死亡率（RD -1.1ポイント）および心不全入院（RD -3.4ポイント）のリスクを有意に低減した。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬はHFrEF患者の予後を改善するが、臨床実務における最適な開始タイミングは不明確であった。本結果は、HFrEFの基礎治療の一部として早期SGLT2阻害薬開始を優先すべきことを支持する。

items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：1年全死因死亡率。副次エンドポイント：心不全入院。

items.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and Risk of Arrhythmias: A Network Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Arrhythmias are often associated with comorbidities such as diabetes and obesity, which significantly influence their onset and progression. In this context, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) have garnered attention for their potential benefits, with emerging evidence indicating that GLP-1 receptor activation might offer antiarrhythmic effects.
OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to evaluate the impact of all GLP-1 RAs and co-agonists on the incidence of new-onset arrhythmias, particularly atrial fibrillation (AF).
METHODS: A comprehensive search of databases was conducted from inception to December 2025. Eligible studies included randomized controlled trials (RCTs) focusing on patients with diabetes or obesity receiving GLP-1 RAs or co-agonists. Risk ratios (RR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated. Interventions were ranked using the p-score cumulative rank, ranging from 0 (worst) to 1 (best).
RESULTS: A total of 94 RCTs involving 155,989 patients were included, comparing 12 GLP-1 RAs and co-agonists. Subcutaneous semaglutide emerged as the most effective intervention, significantly reducing AF incidence compared with placebo (RR 0.82; 95% CI: 0.68 to 0.99), and compared with tirzepatide (RR 0.57; 95% CI: 0.37 to 0.88). In contrast, dulaglutide was associated with an increased risk of AF, while lixisenatide was associated with a decreased risk in atrioventricular blocks. For AF, semaglutide presented a p-score of 0.7885, while tirzepatide and dulaglutide scored 0.1830 and 0.1750, respectively.
CONCLUSION: Among GLP-1 RAs and co-agonists, subcutaneous semaglutide is highlighted as the most effective intervention for reducing the risk of AF. Further studies focusing on arrhythmic outcomes are needed to confirm these findings.
items.authors: Barbosa Lucas M, Rodrigues Oliveira Vinícius Martins, Ruelas Mariano Gallo, Nascimento Bruno R, Moreira Humberto Graner, Nunes Maria do Carmo P, Darrieux Francisco, Lopes Renato D
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）および共作動薬が新規発症不整脈、特に心房細動（AF）の発生に与える影響を評価したネットワークメタアナリシス。2025年12月までのデータベース検索を行い、糖尿病または肥満患者を対象とした94件のRCT（155,989例）を含む12種類のGLP-1 RAおよび共作動薬を比較した。皮下投与セマグルチドがAF発生を最も効果的に低減する介入として示された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 12種類のGLP-1 RAおよび共作動薬の中で、皮下投与セマグルチドが心房細動リスク低減において最も効果的な介入であった（vs プラセボ RR 0.82; 95% CI: 0.68–0.99）。
items.why_matters_ja: 不整脈は糖尿病や肥満といった合併症と関連しており、これらの患者に広く使用されているGLP-1 RAの抗不整脈効果の解明は、薬剤選択において臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: ネットワークメタアナリシス（RCTを対象）
items.endpoints_ja: 新規発症不整脈の発生率、特に心房細動（AF）；房室ブロック
items.endpoint_results_ja: 皮下セマグルチド vs プラセボ（AF）: RR 0.82; 95% CI: 0.68–0.99。皮下セマグルチド vs ティルゼパチド（AF）: RR 0.57; 95% CI: 0.37–0.88。デュラグルチドはAFリスク増加と関連。リクシセナチドは房室ブロックリスク減少と関連。AFのp-score: セマグルチド 0.7885、ティルゼパチド 0.1830、デュラグルチド 0.1750。

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist-associated weight loss in breast cancer patients receiving concurrent endocrine therapy: a retrospective cohort analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Endocrine therapy for hormone receptor-positive breast cancer is associated with adverse metabolic effects - including increased fat mass, decreased lean muscle mass, and insulin resistance - that may attenuate the efficacy of GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs). This study evaluated GLP-1 RA-associated weight loss outcomes in breast cancer patients receiving concurrent endocrine therapy.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort analysis of 269 breast cancer patients at a single academic center receiving concurrent GLP-1 RA and adjuvant endocrine therapy. GLP-1 RA and endocrine therapy data were obtained from electronic medication reconciliation lists and pharmacy dispense reports. Patients were required to have initiated GLP-1 therapy during the study period and to have received concurrent GLP-1 RA and endocrine therapy for at least one year. The primary outcome was percentage weight change from GLP-1 initiation to 12 months (± 2 months). Secondary outcomes included proportions achieving ≥ 5%, ≥ 10%, and ≥ 15% weight loss.
RESULTS: Mean one-year percentage weight loss was - 4.5% (95% CI: -6.0% to - 3.0%; -3.9 kg; 95% CI: -4.96 to - 2.93 kg), significantly below the 10-20% observed in postmenopausal subgroups of GLP-1 randomized trials (all p < 0.001). Only 21.3% achieved ≥ 10% and 10.4% achieved ≥ 15% weight loss. Weight loss differed significantly by GLP-1 agent (p = 0.003); semaglutide (- 5.8%) and tirzepatide (- 4.7%) outperformed dulaglutide (+ 0.1%), which is approved for type 2 diabetes only. Higher baseline weight was associated with greater absolute loss (r = - 0.19, p = 0.002), though percentage weight loss did not differ significantly by baseline BMI category (p = 0.303). PR-negative patients lost more than PR-positive patients (- 8.2% vs. -4.2%; p = 0.021, d = 0.46). Type 2 diabetes was present in 70.6% of patients; T2DM status was not significantly associated with weight loss on t-test (p = 0.288), though patients without T2DM were numerically more likely to achieve ≥ 15% loss (21.5% vs. 5.8%).
CONCLUSIONS: GLP-1 RAs produce statistically significant but substantially attenuated weight loss in breast cancer patients on concurrent endocrine therapy. GLP-1 agent selection significantly influences outcomes. Given emerging evidence of oncologic benefit, prospective trials are needed.
items.authors: Cronin Keri Morgan, Tiersten Amy
items.summary_ja: 単一学術センターで併用GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）と補助内分泌療法を投与された269例の乳癌患者を対象とした後方視コホート解析。GLP-1 RA開始から12ヶ月（±2ヶ月）の体重変化率を主評価項目とし、併用内分泌療法下でのGLP-1 RA関連減量効果を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 併用内分泌療法中の乳癌患者において、GLP-1 RAは統計的に有意だが、GLP-1ランダム化試験の閉経後サブグループで観察された10〜20%に比べて著しく減弱した減量（平均-4.5%）にとどまった。GLP-1製剤の選択が結果に有意に影響した（セマグルチド-5.8%、tirzepatide-4.7%、デュラグルチド+0.1%）。
items.why_matters_ja: ホルモン受容体陽性乳癌の内分泌療法は脂肪量増加・筋量減少・インスリン抵抗性などの代謝性有害事象を伴い、GLP-1 RAの効果を減弱させる可能性がある。GLP-1 RAの腫瘍学的利益に関する証拠が蓄積している中、この集団での減量効果の理解は臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート解析（単一施設）
items.endpoints_ja: 主評価項目：GLP-1開始から12ヶ月（±2ヶ月）の体重変化率。副次評価項目：≥5%、≥10%、≥15%の減量を達成した割合。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 平均1年体重変化率：-4.5%（95% CI: -6.0%〜-3.0%；-3.9 kg；95% CI: -4.96〜-2.93 kg）。≥10%減量達成率：21.3%。≥15%減量達成率：10.4%。製剤別：セマグルチド-5.8%、tirzepatide-4.7%、デュラグルチド+0.1%（p=0.003）。PR陰性 vs PR陽性：-8.2% vs -4.2%（p=0.021, d=0.46）。T2DM有無による体重変化率の差は有意でない（p=0.288）。T2DM非保有者の≥15%減量達成率は数値上21.5% vs 5.8%。ベースライン体重と絶対減量の相関：r=-0.19（p=0.002）。ベースラインBMIカテゴリーによる体重変化率の差は有意でない（p=0.303）。≥5%減量達成率：抄録に記載なし。

items.title: Cardiovascular outcomes of SGLT2 inhibitors across the spectrum of myocardial infarction: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) help in heart failure (HF), but their benefit after acute myocardial infarction is unclear. This meta-analysis assesses their impact on mortality and heart failure hospitalization post-acute myocardial infarction (AMI) and identifies which patients benefit most.
METHODS: Four databases were searched through August 2025 for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and matched studies comparing SGLT2i with control post-AMI.
PRIMARY OUTCOMES: all-cause death and hospitalization for heart failure (HHF); secondary: major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), cardiovascular (CV) death, stroke and recurrent myocardial infarction (MI). Subgroups and meta-regression examined timing, diabetes, follow-up, design, SGLT2i type and baseline HF/diabetes.
RESULTS: Fifteen studies including 117 096 patients (58 613 SGLT2i vs. 58 483 control) were included. A total of 117 096 patients contributed to the all-cause mortality analysis (OR 0.78, 95% CI 0.67-0.90), whereas 116 992 patients across 14 studies contributed to the HHF analysis (OR 0.74, 95% CI 0.63-0.88). All-cause mortality was significantly lower in PSM observational studies (OR 0.64, 95% CI 0.61-0.67), whereas the reduction did not reach statistical significance in RCTs (OR 0.87, 95% CI 0.76-1.01), with a significant interaction by study design. HHF reduction occurred with both early and delayed initiation; dapagliflozin and empagliflozin were similarly effective. MACE was significantly lower with SGLT2i, but CV death, recurrent MI and stroke did not differ. Baseline HF or diabetes showed no association with primary outcomes.
CONCLUSIONS: SGLT2i reduced HHF after MI, but this benefit should be interpreted cautiously because of small-study effects and possible publication bias. The all-cause mortality benefit is driven by observational studies; RCTs show a favourable but nonsignificant trend.
items.authors: Elazab Ahmed, Elbataa Ahmed, Mansour Ahmed, Abouzid Mohamed, Hammad Noha, Hassanin Mohammed Sabri, Abouzkaly Fatma, Alganadi Raghad
items.summary_ja: 急性心筋梗塞（AMI）後のSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）の死亡率および心不全入院への影響を評価したシステマティックレビュー・メタアナリシス。2025年8月までの4データベースからRCTおよびマッチング研究を収集し、15研究・117,096例（SGLT2i群58,613例 vs 対照群58,483例）を解析した。主要アウトカムは全死因死亡および心不全入院（HHF）、二次アウトカムはMACE、心血管死亡、脳卒中、再発心筋梗塞とした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2iはAMI後の心不全入院を有意に減少させた（OR 0.74, 95% CI 0.63-0.88）が、全死因死亡の有意な減少は観察研究に依存しており、RCTでは有意でない良好な傾向にとどまった（OR 0.87, 95% CI 0.76-1.01）。小規模研究効果および出版バイアスの可能性を考慮して解釈すべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2iは心不全（HF）に有効であることが知られているが、急性心筋梗塞後の効果は不明であった。本メタアナリシスは、AMI後のSGLT2iの心血管アウトカムへの影響を大規模な患者群で評価し、どの患者が最も恩恵を受けるかを特定する試みである。
items.study_type_ja: システマティックレビュー・メタアナリシス
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：全死因死亡、心不全入院（HHF）。二次アウトカム：主要心血管事象（MACE）、心血管死亡、脳卒中、再発心筋梗塞。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Characteristics and Treatment Utilisation Patterns of Individuals Using Tirzepatide for Type 2 Diabetes in Germany.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: This study describes real-world characteristics and utilisation patterns of tirzepatide among adults with type 2 diabetes in German office-based practice.
METHODS: This retrospective observational study analysed data from the CompuGroup Medical Healthcare Database. Cohort 1 initiated tirzepatide between 1 December 2023 and 31 March 2024 and cohort 2 between 1 July and 30 September 2024. A subgroup of cohort 1 with ≥ 6 months' follow-up data and uninterrupted tirzepatide use (cohort 1a) was also analysed. Descriptive statistics summarised baseline characteristics, prior therapy, and dosing patterns.
RESULTS: Cohort 1 included 1223 individuals and cohort 2 included 2300; mean (± standard deviation) age was 59 ± 12 and 60 ± 12 years, respectively, and approximately 54% were male. Comorbidities, especially hypertension and dyslipidaemia, were frequent. Most individuals had prior insulin and/or glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) treatment (cohort 1, 72.1%; cohort 2, 59.6%). A total of 458 individuals had 6 months' follow-up (cohort 1a). The most common starting dose was 2.5 mg (71.2%). Use of higher doses gradually increased over time, with 5.0 mg becoming the most prevalent; at 6 months, 35.9% of individuals received 5.0 mg and 18.6% received 10.0 mg.
CONCLUSION: This first comprehensive real-world study of tirzepatide use in Germany showed tirzepatide initiation primarily after GLP-1 RA and/or insulin therapy. Most individuals remained on 5.0 mg, with a notable proportion escalating to 10.0 mg. Cohort characteristics were generally similar to those in the SURPASS trials, supporting the relevance of trial findings to clinical practice.
items.authors: Füchtenbusch Martin, Kraus Marius, Heitmann Elke, Wilhelm Stefan, Schwarz Leonora, Bendel Jens, Hennies Nora
items.summary_ja: ドイツの外来診療における2型糖尿病患者のtirzepatide使用の実世界の特徴と利用パターンを記述する後向き観察研究。CompuGroup Medical Healthcare Databaseを用い、コホート1（2023年12月1日〜2024年3月31日にtirzepatideを開始、n=1223）とコホート2（2024年7月1日〜9月30日に開始、n=2300）を分析。コホート1から6か月以上のフォローアップデータがありtirzepatide使用が途絶えていないサブグループ（コホート1a、n=458）も解析。ベースライン特徴、既往治療、投与パターンの記述統計を要約した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ドイツにおけるtirzepatideの開始は主にGLP-1 RAおよび/またはインスリン治療の後に実施されていた。大多数の患者が5.0 mgを維持し、10.0 mgへエスカレーションした割合も一定数存在した。コホートの特徴はSURPASS試験と概ね類似しており、試験結果の臨床実践への関連性を支持した。
items.why_matters_ja: ドイツにおけるtirzepatide使用の包括的な実世界研究として初めてであり、SURPASS試験のコホート特徴との類似性から、試験結果が臨床実践に適用可能であることを示唆する。
items.study_type_ja: 後向き観察研究（実世界研究）
items.endpoints_ja: ベースライン特徴、既往治療、投与パターンの記述統計（主要な臨床エンドポイントの報告なし）
items.endpoint_results_ja: コホート1: 1223名、コホート2: 2300名。平均年齢: 59±12歳（コホート1）、60±12歳（コホート2）。男性約54%。既往インスリンおよび/またはGLP-1 RA治療: コホート1 72.1%、コホート2 59.6%。コホート1a: 458名。最も一般的な開始用量: 2.5 mg（71.2%）。6か月時点で5.0 mg: 35.9%、10.0 mg: 18.6%。
items.sample_size_ja: コホート1: 1223名、コホート2: 2300名、コホート1a（サブグループ）: 458名

items.title: Same Class, Different Risk? Dapagliflozin versus Empagliflozin and Genitourinary Safety in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction: A Retrospective Comparative Cohort Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors are guideline-directed therapy for heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), but comparative genitourinary safety data for dapagliflozin and empagliflozin in HFpEF-treated populations remain limited.
OBJECTIVE: To compare 6-month symptomatic urinary tract infection (UTI), asymptomatic bacteriuria, and other genitourinary adverse events among patients newly initiated on dapagliflozin or empagliflozin for HFpEF.
METHODS: This retrospective, single-centre comparative cohort study included 239 adults with physician-documented HFpEF retained after a requirement for at least 6 months of continuous follow-up: 113 received dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily and 126 received empagliflozin 10 mg once daily. The original outcome of any documented bacteriuria/UTI was separated into symptomatic UTI and asymptomatic bacteriuria. Risk differences and 95% confidence intervals were calculated; a multivariable logistic model of the original documented bacteriuria/UTI composite adjusted for age, sex, and baseline estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR).
RESULTS: Any documented bacteriuria/UTI occurred in 21/113 (18.6%) dapagliflozin-treated participants and 25/126 (19.8%) empagliflozin-treated participants. Symptomatic UTI occurred in 4/113 (3.5%) and 5/126 (4.0%), respectively; 17/113 (15.0%) and 20/126 (15.9%) had documented asymptomatic bacteriuria. The risk difference for the composite, calculated as empagliflozin minus dapagliflozin, was 1.3 percentage points (95% CI -8.9 to 11.2). The adjusted odds ratio was 1.62 (95% CI 0.76-3.45; p = 0.208). Other genitourinary events were uncommon and estimates were imprecise.
CONCLUSIONS: No statistically detectable between-group difference was found in symptomatic UTI, asymptomatic bacteriuria, or the original composite outcome. Confidence intervals were wide and compatible with clinically meaningful differences in either direction. These exploratory findings require confirmation in prospective multicentre studies with standardized culture ascertainment and complete follow-up.

items.authors: Danau Razvan Alexandru, Munteanu Madalina Andreea, Muraru Minerva, Nicolae Camelia, Predoiu Gabriel, Bardan Andreea, Jinga Viorel
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬はHFpEFのガイドライン推奨治療であるが、HFpEF治療患者におけるダパグリフロジンとエンパグリフロジンの泌尿器系安全性の比較データは限定的である。本研究は、HFpEFで新規にダパグリフロジン10mgまたはエンパグリフロジン10mgを開始した239例の成人を対象に、6ヶ月間の症状性尿路感染症（UTI）、無症候性細菌尿、その他の泌尿器系有害事象を比較した後ろ向き単一施設コホート研究である。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 症状性UTI、無症候性細菌尿、および複合アウトカム（文書化された細菌尿/UTI）において、ダパグリフロジンとエンパグリフロジンの間に統計的に検出可能な群間差は認められなかった。ただし信頼区間が広く、臨床的に有意な差がどちらの方向にも存在する可能性を排除できない。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬はHFpEFのガイドライン推奨治療であるが、両薬剤の泌尿器系安全性の比較データは限定的であり、臨床現場での薬剤選択に参考となる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き単一施設比較コホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: 複合アウトカム：文書化された細菌尿/UTI（任意）。二次：症状性尿路感染症（UTI）、無症候性細菌尿、その他の泌尿器系有害事象。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 文書化された細菌尿/UTI（複合）：ダパグリフロジン群 21/113（18.6%）、エンパグリフロジン群 25/126（19.8%）。リスク差（エンパグリフロジン−ダパグリフロジン）：1.3ポイント（95% CI −8.9〜11.2）。調整オッズ比：1.62（95% CI 0.76〜3.45；p=0.208）。症状性UTI：ダパグリフロジン群 4/113（3.5%）、エンパグリフロジン群 5/126（4.0%）。無症候性細菌尿：ダパグリフロジン群 17/113（15.0%）、エンパグリフロジン群 20/126（15.9%）。その他の泌尿器系事象はまれであり、推定値は不正確であった。
items.sample_size_ja: 239例（ダパグリフロジン群113例、エンパグリフロジン群126例）

items.title: Neuropsychiatric Outcomes Associated With GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Use in Medicare Beneficiaries With Type 2 Diabetes: Variation by Treatment Pattern and Obesity Status.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptors are expressed in brain regions governing mood, reward and stress, yet the neuropsychiatric effects of GLP-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) therapy remain poorly characterized. We estimated associations between GLP-1 RA use and neuropsychiatric disorders and variation by obesity status and treatment pattern.
MATERIAL AND METHODS: This population-based cohort study used claims data from Medicare enrolees with Type 2 diabetes mellitus. GLP-1 RAs were compared with other second-line glucose-lowering medications and evaluated across four treatment patterns: monotherapy, switch, escalation and augmentation. Eight neuropsychiatric outcomes were examined using 1:1 propensity score-matched, covariate-adjusted stratified Cox regression with time-varying covariates.
RESULTS: GLP-1 RA use was associated with a small increase in aggregate psychiatric disorder risk (Hazard Ratio [HR] = 1.04; 95% Confidence Interval: 1.03-1.06; 1.7 excess events/1000 person-years), of uncertain clinical significance given the large cohort size. Risk was elevated for depression (HR = 1.11; 3.0 excess events/1000 person-years) but reduced for substance use disorders (HR = 0.84; 4.1 fewer events/1000 person-years), dementia (HR = 0.87; 2.8 fewer) and suicidal/self-harm (HR = 0.81; 0.4 fewer events/1000 person-years). Associations varied by treatment pattern: monotherapy showed elevated psychiatric (HR = 1.43) and elevated emotional symptom (HR = 1.32) risks; escalation also exhibited elevated psychiatric risk, whereas switch and augmentation demonstrated reduced or null risks.
CONCLUSIONS: Rather than a uniform class effect, the neuropsychiatric profile of GLP-1 RA appears context-dependent, differing by treatment pattern, obesity status and outcome examined. Elevated risk with monotherapy or escalation may reflect baseline clinical differences rather than pharmacological effect. Reduced risks of substance use disorders, dementia and suicidal/self-harm are reassuring.
items.authors: Baik Seo Hyon, Baye Fitsum, Xian Haotian, Fung Kin Wah, McDonald Clement J
items.summary_ja: Medicare加入の2型糖尿病患者を対象とした人口ベースコホート研究であり、GLP-1受容体アゴニスト（GLP-1 RA）の使用と神経精神疾患の関連を、他の第二線降糖薬と比較して評価した。4つの治療パターン（単独療法、切り替え、エスカレーション、増量）ごとに、1:1プロパensityスコアマッチング、共変量調整、時間変動共変量を含む層別Cox回帰分析を用いて8つの神経精神アウトカムを解析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RAの神経精神プロファイルは均一なクラス効果ではなく、治療パターン・肥満状態・評価するアウトカムによって異なる文脈依存性を持つ。単独療法やエスカレーションでのリスク上昇は薬理学的効果ではなくベースライン臨床差を反映している可能性があり、物質使用障害・認知症・自殺/自傷のリスク低下は安心材料である。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1 RAは2型糖尿病治療で広く使用されているが、脳内のGLP-1受容体は気分・報酬・ストレスを支配する領域に発現しており、神経精神的安全性プロファイルの明確化は臨床判断に重要である。治療パターンによるリスク変動の理解は、どの患者にどの使い方をすべきかの判断に直接寄与する。
items.study_type_ja: 人口ベースコホート研究（Medicare請求データ）
items.endpoints_ja: 8つの神経精神アウトカム（集計精神疾患、うつ病、物質使用障害、認知症、自殺/自傷、感情症状など）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 集計精神疾患: HR=1.04 (95% CI: 1.03-1.06), 1.7 excess events/1000 person-years; うつ病: HR=1.11, 3.0 excess events/1000 person-years; 物質使用障害: HR=0.84, 4.1 fewer events/1000 person-years; 認知症: HR=0.87, 2.8 fewer events/1000 person-years; 自殺/自傷: HR=0.81, 0.4 fewer events/1000 person-years; 単独療法: 精神疾患 HR=1.43, 感情症状 HR=1.32

items.title: Impact of Semaglutide Introduction on the Use of Concomitant Medications: An Interrupted Time Series.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To evaluate the impact of semaglutide initiation for weight management on the use of concomitant medications commonly prescribed for obesity-related comorbidities.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We conducted a nationwide interrupted time series study using data from Danish registers, including adults initiating semaglutide for weight management between 12/2022 and 12/2024. Monthly prescriptions for 10 medication classes were analysed in the 24 months before and 12 months after initiation. Effects at 12 months were expressed as rate ratios (RRs) comparing observed values with expected values based on pre-initiation trends.
RESULTS: Among 189 392 semaglutide initiators (68% women; median age 50 years), prescription volumes at 12 months declined and were lower than projected from pre-initiation trends for antiasthmatics (RR: 0.82, 95% confidence interval 0.79-0.86), topical corticosteroids (0.91, 0.87-0.96), antipsoriatics (0.91, 0.83-1.00), analgesics (0.93, 0.90-0.96), antidepressants (0.93, 0.89-0.98) and topical antifungal formulations (0.92, 0.86-0.99). Antihypertensive prescriptions continued to rise after semaglutide initiation, but more slowly than projected (0.92, 0.89-0.95). Glucose-lowering medications declined (0.87, 0.82-0.92), mainly non-insulin agents, but a similar reduction was observed in the negative control cohort. Anxiolytic use increased (1.16, 1.08-1.24) and remained elevated at 2 years. Changes in lipid-modifying agents and medications for gastric acid disorders were small or transient.
CONCLUSIONS: Semaglutide initiation for weight management was associated with reduced use of several concomitant medications for obesity-related comorbidities, while anxiolytic use increased. Changes in other therapeutic classes were limited. These findings suggest that semaglutide treatment may influence overall medication use and support continued monitoring of prescribing patterns during therapy.
items.authors: Roland Noémie, Sonne Heidi, Mose Katrine, Kjærgaard Katrine, Lundby Carina, Bramming Maja, Cardél Lise Gehrt, Pottegård Anton
items.summary_ja: デンマークの全国登録データを用いた中断時間系列研究であり、2022年12月から2024年12月の間に体重管理目的でセマグルチドを開始した成人189,392名を対象に、開始前24か月と開始後12か月の10薬剤クラスの処方量の変化を評価した。開始後12か月時点で、気管支喘息薬、外用ステロイド、抗乾癬薬、鎮痛薬、抗うつ薬、外用抗真菌薬の処方量が開始前のトレンドに基づく予測値より低下し、降圧薬は上昇が続いたが予測より緩やかであった。降糖薬は低下したが、ネガティブコントロールコホートでも同様の減少が認められた。抗不安薬の用量は増加し、2年後まで高値を維持した。脂質調整薬と胃酸疾患治療薬の変化は小規模または一過性であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 体重管理目的のセマグルチド開始は、肥満関連合併症に対する複数の併用薬の用量減少と関連したが、抗不安薬の用量は増加した。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチド治療が全体的な薬剤使用に影響を与える可能性を示し、治療中の処方パターンの継続的モニタリングを支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 全国規模の中断時間系列研究（デンマーク登録データ）
items.endpoints_ja: セマグルチド開始後12か月時点の10薬剤クラス（気管支喘息薬、外用ステロイド、抗乾癬薬、鎮痛薬、抗うつ薬、外用抗真菌薬、降圧薬、降糖薬、抗不安薬、脂質調整薬、胃酸疾患治療薬）の処方量。開始前トレンドに基づく予測値との比較としてハザード比（RR）で表現。

items.title: Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibitor Use and Levels of Hemoglobin, Markers of Iron Metabolism, and Erythropoiesis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Clinical Trials.
items.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: In randomized clinical trials, sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor use was associated with increased hemoglobin and hematocrit compared with placebo. However, the magnitude and importance of this association remain unclear.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the associations between SGLT2 inhibitor use and levels of hemoglobin, hematocrit, and markers of iron metabolism and erythropoiesis compared with placebo or active comparator.
DATA SOURCES: PubMed, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) were searched from inception to July 22, 2026.
STUDY SELECTION: Randomized, double-masked clinical trials comparing SGLT2 inhibitor use with placebo or active comparators in patients with 1 or more of the following conditions: cardiovascular disease, diabetes, heart failure, and chronic kidney disease.
DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: Three reviewers independently extracted data and results were pooled using random-effects meta-analysis.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Primary outcomes were changes in hemoglobin and hematocrit. Secondary outcomes were changes in red blood cell concentration, erythropoietin (EPO), and iron measures (serum iron, ferritin, transferrin saturation, and hepcidin).
RESULTS: A total of 85 randomized clinical trials were analyzed (median [IQR] duration, 24 [12-32] weeks), including 70 543 participants (mean [SD] age, 62.4 [9.4] years; 25 334 female [35.9%]). Mean (SD) baseline hemoglobin was 13.6 (1.5) g/dL; baseline hematocrit was 41.5% (4.9). Seventy-eight clinical trials (67 208 participants) compared SGLT2 inhibitors with placebo, and 7 clinical trials (3335 participants) used active comparators, most commonly sitagliptin (2 trials [1158 participants]). From baseline to follow-up, hemoglobin changed by 0.55 g/dL (95% CI, 0.49 to 0.61 g/dL; P < .001) in the SGLT2 inhibitor group, and -0.08 g/dL (95% CI, -0.13 to -0.03 g/dL; P = .003) in the control group (difference, 0.60 g/dL; 95% CI, 0.55 to 0.66 g/dL; P < .001). From baseline to follow-up, hematocrit changed by 2.17% (95% CI, 1.95% to 2.39%; P < .001) in the SGLT2 inhibitor group and -0.13% (95% CI, -0.28% to 0.01%; P = .07) in the control group (difference, 2.36%; 95% CI, 2.19% to 2.52%; P < .001). Of the 6 secondary outcomes, 4 showed significant associations with SGLT2 inhibitors, including increased EPO (2.35 mIU/mL in SGLT2 inhibitor group vs 0.04 mIU/mL in control group; difference, 2.11 mIU/mL [95% CI, 0.5-3.71 mIU/mL]; P = .01) and decreased transferrin saturation (-2.2% in SGLT2 inhibitor group vs -0.10% in control group; difference, -0.84% [95% CI, -1.21% to -0.47%]; P < .001).
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In a meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials, compared with control, SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with small statistically significant increases in hemoglobin and hematocrit levels. The clinical significance of these findings is unclear.
items.authors: Yang Yaqin, Yang Changyuan, Wang Yanmei, Rawee Pien, Cases Aleix, Leaf David E, Del Vecchio Lucia, Muka Taulant
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の使用がヘモグロビン、ヘマトクリット、鉄代謝マーカーおよび赤血球産生マーカーに与える影響を、プラセボまたは活性対照と比較して評価したランダム化比較試験（RCT）の系統的レビューおよびメタ解析。85件のRCT（中央値期間24週間、参加者70,543名）を解析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の使用は、対照群と比較してヘモグロビン（差 0.60 g/dL）およびヘマトクリット（差 2.36%）の統計的に有意な軽度の増加と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬によるヘモグロビン・ヘマトクリットの増加の臨床的意義は不明である（抄録の結論部に明記）。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビューおよびメタ解析（ランダム化比較試験）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：ヘモグロビンおよびヘマトクリットの変化。二次エンドポイント：赤血球濃度、エリスロポエチン（EPO）、鉄関連指標（血清鉄、フェリチン、トランスフェリン飽和度、ヘプシジン）の変化。

items.title: Parasympathetic dysfunction assessed by deep-breathing CVR-R is associated with early discontinuation of oral semaglutide in type 2 diabetes: A multicenter retrospective study.
items.abstract:
AIMS/INTRODUCTION: Although glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists are widely used for type 2 diabetes, gastrointestinal intolerance frequently leads to early discontinuation. Predictors of oral semaglutide discontinuation remain poorly defined, and its formulation-specific dependence on gastric conditions may influence tolerability. We examined whether the coefficient of variation of R-R intervals (CVR-R) was associated with discontinuation within 6 months.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this multicenter retrospective study, 203 consecutive patients initiating oral semaglutide between February 2021 and December 2024 were screened, and 61 were analyzed after exclusions. The Discontinuation Group (n = 21) discontinued because of nausea and/or vomiting within 6 months, whereas the Maintenance Group (n = 40) continued for ≥ 6 months. CVR-R was assessed at rest (CVR-R_rest) and during deep breathing (CVR-R_DB). Associations with discontinuation were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression; exploratory machine learning and time-to-event analyses were performed.
RESULTS: CVR-R_DB was lower in the Discontinuation Group than in the Maintenance Group (median 1.93% vs 3.26%, P < 0.001). CVR-R_DB remained independently associated with discontinuation after adjustment for age and sex (adjusted OR 0.191; 95% CI 0.071-0.512; P = 0.001; AUC 0.832) and further adjustment for neuropathy stage. The AUC was numerically higher for the age- and sex-adjusted model containing CVR-R_DB than for that containing CVR-R_rest (0.832 vs 0.699; DeLong P = 0.085). An internally derived CVR-R_DB cutoff of 2.55% stratified 6-month persistence (43.3% vs 87.1%; log-rank P < 0.001), and machine learning analyses prioritized CVR-R_DB.
CONCLUSIONS: Lower CVR-R during deep breathing was associated with early oral semaglutide discontinuation due to nausea and/or vomiting. CVR-R_DB may support risk stratification at initiation.

items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病患者において、経口セマグルチドの早期中止（6ヶ月以内の悪心/嘔吐による中止）と深呼吸時CVR-R（R-R間隔の変動係数）との関連を評価した多施設後ろ向き研究。203例をスクリーニングし、除外後61例を解析した。中止群（n=21）と継続群（n=40）で比較し、多変量ロジスティック回帰、探索的機械学習、時間至イベント解析を行った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 深呼吸時CVR-R（CVR-R_DB）が低いほど、経口セマグルチドの悪心/嘔吐による6ヶ月以内の早期中止リスクが高い。CVR-R_DBは開始時のリスク層別化に有用な可能性を示した。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬は2型糖尿病で広く使用されているが、消化管不耐性が早期中止の主要因であり、その予測因子は十分に定義されていない。経口セマグルチドは胃状態への製剤固有の依存性があり、耐性に影響する可能性がある。CVR-R_DBは開始時のリスク層別化に活用できる可能性がある。

items.title: A rare diagnosis during evaluation for metabolic dysfunction associated steatotic liver disease: Glycogen storage disease type Ia presenting during adolescence in a male with severe obesity.
items.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a common comorbidity of pediatric obesity that predisposes patients to hepatocellular adenomas (HCAs). HCAs however are nonspecific to MASLD and warrant further evaluation. We present a case of a 16-year-old male with severe obesity, and persistently elevated liver enzymes, initially evaluated for MASLD. Imaging revealed multiple hepatic lesions consistent with HCAs, prompting further genetic evaluation. Trio exome sequencing identified biallelic variants in the glucose-6-phophatase gene, confirming a diagnosis of glycogen storage disease type Ia (GSD Ia). This case highlights the diagnostic challenge posed by overlapping features of MASLD and GSD Ia, particularly hepatic steatosis, HCAs, and metabolic syndrome. Initial management of MASLD with glucagon-like peptide-1 therapy was discontinued given risk for hypoglycemia, and the patient continues glucose monitoring and cornstarch therapy. This case emphasizes the importance of including inborn errors of metabolism in the differential diagnosis for multifocal HCAs and concerns with obesity treatments.
items.authors: Trocchia Carolena, Herdes Rachel, Gedallovich Jodi, Narang Amrita
items.summary_ja: 重症肥満を伴う16歳男性がMASLDの評価を目的に受診し、持続的な肝酵素上昇を認めた。画像検査でHCAsと一致する多発肝病変が認められ、トリオエクソーム解析によりグルコース-6-ホスファターゼ遺伝子の双側変異が同定され、グリコーゲン貯留症型Ia（GSD Ia）と診断された。当初のMASLDに対するGLP-1療法は低血糖リスクを理由に中止され、血糖モニタリングとコーンスターチ療法を継続している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: MASLDとGSD Iaは肝脂肪症、HCAs、代謝症候群などの臨床所見が重複しており、多発HCAsを認める肥満患者では先天性代謝異常症を鑑別に含めることが重要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満患者における多発HCAsの鑑別に先天性代謝異常症を含めることの重要性を示し、未診断のGSD患者に対する肥満治療（GLP-1療法）の低血糖リスクに関する注意を喚起する。

items.title: Skeletal effects of GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy in adults with overweight or obesity: a systematic review.
items.abstract:
UNLABELLED: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are widely used for weight management, yet their skeletal effects remain unclear. This systematic review of eight randomized controlled trials (n = 493) evaluating dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA)-derived bone mineral density reports findings separately for each agent, without pooling, because the trials evaluated four pharmacologically distinct agents differing markedly in weight-lowering potency. The evidence is sparse for every agent and is insufficient to establish the skeletal effects of GLP-1 RA therapy in this population.
PURPOSE: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are widely used for weight management, yet their skeletal effects remain uncertain. We systematically reviewed the randomized evidence on bone mineral density (BMD) and bone turnover markers in adults with overweight or obesity, reporting findings separately for each individual agent.
METHODS: This PRISMA 2020-compliant systematic review (INPLASY202630076) searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane CENTRAL, and Google Scholar (January 2015 to July 2026). Eligible randomized controlled trials (RCTs) enrolled adults aged ≥18 years with mean baseline body mass index (BMI) > 25 kg/m², compared a GLP-1 RA with placebo or another antidiabetic therapy for ≥12 weeks, and reported BMD assessed by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA). Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 (RoB 2) tool and certainty of evidence using GRADE. Because the included trials evaluated pharmacologically distinct agents that differ substantially in weight-lowering potency, results were synthesized narratively and reported separately by agent; no meta-analysis was performed.
RESULTS: Eight RCTs (n = 493) were included. Three trials were at low risk of bias (Eriksson 2019; Hygum 2020; Hansen 2024) and five raised some concerns, principally regarding the randomization process and selective reporting; no agent is supported by more than one trial at low risk of bias. (Cai 2021 contributes two treatment arms assessed separately, giving nine comparisons in the risk-of-bias assessment.) Evidence was unevenly distributed across agents: semaglutide and dulaglutide were each evaluated in one trial, liraglutide in two, and exenatide in five. Five of the eight trials enrolled adults with type 2 diabetes, including all four that randomized an insulin comparator arm; three enrolled adults without diabetes, of which one was defined by obesity alone. By study-level mean baseline BMI, five trials lay in the obese range ( ≥ 30 kg/m²) and three in the overweight range (25 to <30 kg/m²). The single semaglutide trial (Hansen 2024; n = 64; low risk of bias), which produced the largest weight loss of any trial (estimated treatment difference [ETD] -6.8 kg vs placebo), reported reduced lumbar spine BMD (ETD - 0.018 g/cm², p = 0.007), reduced whole-body BMD (mean difference [MD] -0.02 g/cm²; 95% CI - 0.03 to -0.01), and increased C-terminal telopeptide (CTX; MD 166.50 pg/mL; 95% CI 66.60 to 266.40). Liraglutide was evaluated at two doses with divergent results. At the weight-management dose of 3.0 mg daily, in the only trial conducted in adults with obesity and without diabetes (Jensen 2024; ETD - 6.7 kg vs placebo), lumbar spine BMD (MD - 0.019 g/cm²; 95% CI - 0.034 to -0.004) and total hip BMD (MD - 0.013 g/cm²; 95% CI - 0.024 to -0.002) were reduced. At the diabetes dose of 1.8 mg daily (Hygum 2020; -3.8 kg), no site changed materially (lumbar spine MD 0.00 g/cm²; 95% CI - 0.01 to 0.01). Exenatide trials were inconsistent, ranging from 0.03 g/cm² (95% CI 0.02 to 0.03) at the lumbar spine (Renyuan 2015) to -0.04 g/cm² (95% CI - 0.15 to 0.07; Akyay 2023). Certainty of evidence was very low for every agent.
CONCLUSION: The randomized evidence is too sparse and too clinically heterogeneous to determine the skeletal effects of GLP-1 RA therapy in adults with overweight or obesity. Each agent has been evaluated in at most five small trials, most conducted in adults with type 2 diabetes rather than in adults with obesity alone. The two trials producing the largest weight loss, one of semaglutide and one of liraglutide 3.0 mg, both reported reduced lumbar spine and total hip BMD at closely similar magnitudes of weight loss, and the semaglutide trial additionally reported increased bone resorption. This convergence warrants dedicated evaluation rather than extrapolation across the drug class. Adequately powered, agent-specific trials with fracture endpoints are required.

items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）の骨代謝への影響を評価した8件のランダム化比較試験（n=493）の系統的レビュー。DXAによる骨密度（BMD）および骨代謝マーカーの結果を、薬剤ごとに個別に報告（メタ分析は実施せず）。セマグルチド、リラグルチド、エクセナチド、デュラグルチドの4薬剤が対象。全薬剤について証拠は乏しく、GLP-1 RA療法の骨への影響を確立するには不十分であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RA療法の骨への影響を決定するには、ランダム化証拠が過に乏しく臨床的に異質である。最大の減量効果を示した2試験（セマグルチドおよびリラグルチド3.0 mg）はいずれも腰椎および大腿骨頭BMDの低下を報告しており、薬剤クラス全体の外挿ではなく、薬剤ごとの個別評価が必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1 RAは肥満・過体重の体重管理に広く使用されているが、その骨への影響は不確実である。最大の減量を伴う試験でBMD低下が観察されたことは、これらの薬剤の長期使用における骨健康への影響を評価する必要性を示唆する。

items.title: GLP-1-based therapies in cardiovascular disease: outcomes, mechanisms, and emerging clinical applications.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) have shown cardiovascular benefits beyond their established role in treating type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). This review evaluates recent clinical evidence, potential mechanisms, and the expanding use of GLP-1-based therapies in cardiovascular disease.
METHODS: We reviewed major randomized clinical trials assessing cardiovascular, kidney, and heart failure outcomes, along with related mechanistic studies and clinical guidelines published through July 2026.
RESULTS: Early trials, including LEADER, SUSTAIN-6, and REWIND, reported 12%-26% reductions in major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in patients with T2DM. More recent trials have extended these findings to other populations. SELECT showed a 20% reduction in MACE among individuals with obesity and established cardiovascular disease but without diabetes, while FLOW demonstrated a 24% reduction in its primary kidney composite outcome. SOUL reported a 14% reduction in MACE with oral semaglutide, and SUMMIT showed a 38% reduction in cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure with tirzepatide. SURPASS-CVOT found tirzepatide to be noninferior, but not superior, to dulaglutide for MACE. These benefits likely involve several mechanisms beyond glucose lowering and weight loss, although gastrointestinal adverse effects still remain a concern.
CONCLUSIONS: Growing clinical evidence supports the use of GLP-1-based therapies beyond diabetes management, particularly in patients with cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, or obesity-related heart failure. Further studies will be needed to understand their mechanisms better, long-term safety, and optimal use in clinical practice.
items.authors: Jang Rachelle, Jang Michelle, Ruan Xinyuan, Jin Caden, Kim Woo
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）は2型糖尿病治療における確立された役割を超えて心血管系に有益な効果を示している。本総説は、心血管・腎・心不全の転帰を評価した主要なランダム化比較試験、関連する機序研究、および2026年7月までに発表された臨床ガイドラインをレビューし、GLP-1系療法の心血管疾患における臨床エビデンス、潜在的な機序、および拡大適用を評価している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1系療法は糖尿病管理を超えて心血管疾患、慢性腎臓病、肥満関連心不全の患者において有益であり、MACEの12〜26%減少（T2DM患者）、肥満・心血管疾患あり糖尿病なしの患者でのMACE 20%減少（SELECT）、腎複合転帰の24%減少（FLOW）、心血管死または心不全悪化の38%減少（SUMMIT）が報告されている。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1系療法の糖尿病管理以外の心血管疾患・慢性腎臓病・肥満関連心不全への適用を支持する臨床エビデンスが蓄積しており、臨床実践における最適使用の指針となる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 総説（Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要心血管不良事象（MACE）、主要腎複合転帰、心血管死または心不全悪化、MACE（非劣性・優越性）
items.endpoint_results_ja: LEADER, SUSTAIN-6, REWIND: T2DM患者でMACE 12%-26%減少。SELECT: 肥満かつ心血管疾患あり糖尿病なしの患者でMACE 20%減少。FLOW: 主要腎複合転帰 24%減少。SOUL: 経口セマグルチドでMACE 14%減少。SUMMIT: テルゼパチドで心血管死または心不全悪化 38%減少。SURPASS-CVOT: テルゼパチドはデュラグルチドに対してMACEで非劣性だが優越性は示されなかった。

items.title: Pharmacotherapy for MASLD: current evidence and challenges in clinical practice.
items.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is characterized by a complex pathophysiology driven by intertwined metabolic and hepatic pathways, enabling the identification of multiple therapeutic targets and a rapidly expanding drug development pipeline. This review summarizes the current and emerging therapeutic landscape for MASLD and discusses key challenges for clinical implementation. The imminent availability of several new therapies is expected to pose important clinical challenges, particularly in accurately identifying patients most likely to benefit. Currently, resmetirom and semaglutide are the only two drugs conditionally approved for patients with fibrosis stages 2-3, pending final phase 3 outcomes, and represent the main liver-directed and metabolic-focused therapeutic strategies, respectively. Treatment selection should follow a phenotype-based approach integrating metabolic profile and liver disease stage. Non-invasive tests are central for assessing treatment eligibility; however, strategies incorporating metabolic risk profiling and longitudinal monitoring will be essential to optimize real-world management of MASH.
items.authors: Pages Laura, Rojo Diego, Jimenez-Masip Alba, Tricarico Elena, Mas Eduard, Aguilar Anna, Gomez Nerea, Molinero Lucia
items.summary_ja: MASLD（代謝機能異常関連脂肪性肝疾患）の現在の治療と今後の治療の現状を総説し、臨床導入における主要な課題を議論したレビュー記事。resmetiromとsemaglutideが線維化ステージ2〜3の患者に対して条件付き承認されている唯一の2薬剤であり、それぞれ肝臓指向型と代謝指向型の治療戦略を代表している。治療選択は代謝プロファイルと肝疾患ステージを統合したフェノタイプベースのアプローチに従うべきであり、非侵襲的検査が治療適格性の評価に中核的である。
items.key_takeaway_ja: MASLDの治療選択は、代謝プロファイルと肝疾患ステージを統合したフェノタイプベースのアプローチに従うべきであり、非侵襲的検査が治療適格性の評価に中核的である。
items.why_matters_ja: MASLDは複雑な病態生理を有し、複数の治療ターゲットの同定が可能であり、薬剤開発パイプラインが急速に拡大している。複数の新薬の imminent な利用可能性は、最も恩恵を受ける可能性が高い患者を正確に同定するという重要な臨床的課題を提起する。

items.title: Finerenone-Empagliflozin Combination Therapy in Apparent Resistant Hypertension: A CONFIDENCE Trial Post Hoc Analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Apparent treatment-resistant hypertension (aTRH) is common in chronic kidney disease (CKD) with type 2 diabetes and predicts worse outcomes. Spironolactone, the established fourth-line agent, is limited by hyperkalemia in CKD.
OBJECTIVES: This analysis assessed whether finerenone plus empagliflozin lowers blood pressure (BP) meaningfully in aTRH, and whether aTRH modifies these agents' efficacy and safety.
METHODS: Post hoc analysis of CONFIDENCE (NCT05254002), a double-blind randomized trial of finerenone, empagliflozin, or both in CKD with albuminuria and type 2 diabetes. aTRH was BP ≥130/80 mm Hg on 3 antihypertensive drugs, or ≥4 drugs regardless of BP. Mixed models and logistic regression identified predictors of BP response.
RESULTS: Of the 796 participants, 307 (39%) had aTRH; they were older, more obese, and had more atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, higher albuminuria, and higher systolic BP (140.9 vs 131.5 mm Hg) but similar estimated glomerular filtration rate (53 vs 55 mL/min/1.73 m2). Combination therapy lowered systolic BP more than either monotherapy. Independent predictors of a ≥10 mm Hg systolic BP fall were aTRH (OR: 1.56; 95% CI: 1.08-2.25) and higher baseline estimated glomerular filtration rate (OR: 1.15 per 10 mL/min/1.73 m2; 95% CI: 1.05-1.26); diuretic use and albuminuria were not. The aTRH effect was treatment-independent (interaction P = 0.21). Adverse events were more frequent with aTRH (63.8% vs 51.1%), yet on combination therapy hyperkalemia was less frequent (11.2% vs 17.5%).
CONCLUSIONS: aTRH affected approximately 40% of participants and marked a higher-risk phenotype responsive to finerenone-empagliflozin, with BP reductions comparable to spironolactone but without the excess hyperkalemia that limits its use in CKD.
items.authors: Agarwal Rajiv, Navaneethan Sankar D, Correa-Rotter Ricardo, Estrella Michelle M, Heerspink Hiddo J L, McGill Janet B, Mottl Amy K, Nangaku Masaomi
items.summary_ja: CONFIDENCE試験（NCT05254002）のpost hoc解析として、アルブミン尿を伴う2型糖尿病性CKD患者におけるfinerenone＋empagliflozin併用療法が、明らかな治療抵抗性高血圧（aTRH）患者の血圧を有意に低下させるか、またaTRHがこれらの薬剤の有効性及び安全性にどのように影響するかを評価した。二重盲検無作為化試験の796例中307例（39%）がaTRHに該当し、併用療法は単独療法よりも収縮期血圧を大きく低下させた。aTRHは収縮期血圧10 mm Hg以上の低下の独立予測因子であった（OR 1.56; 95% CI 1.08-2.25）。aTRH患者では有害事象の頻度が高かった（63.8% vs 51.1%）が、併用療法時の高カリウム血症はむしろ少なかった（11.2% vs 17.5%）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: aTRHはfinerenone-empagliflozin併用療法に対する血圧応答が大きい高リスク表現型であり、spironolactoneと同等の血圧低下効果を示しつつ、CKDで問題となる高カリウム血症の増悪を伴わない可能性が示唆された。
items.why_matters_ja: aTRHはCKDを伴う2型糖尿病において頻度高く、予後不良を予測する。確立された第4線薬であるspironolactoneはCKD患者において高カリウム血症により使用が制限されるため、finerenone-empagliflozin併用療法はCKDにおけるaTRH治療の新たな選択肢となり得る。
items.study_type_ja: 二重盲検無作為化試験（CONFIDENCE試験, NCT05254002）のpost hoc解析
items.endpoints_ja: 収縮期血圧の低下（併用療法 vs 単独療法）、収縮期血圧10 mm Hg以上低下の独立予測因子の同定、有害事象および高カリウム血症の頻度
items.endpoint_results_ja: aTRH該当者: 307/796例（39%）。aTRH群 vs 非aTRH群のベースライン収縮期血圧: 140.9 vs 131.5 mm Hg。eGFR: 53 vs 55 mL/min/1.73 m2。収縮期血圧10 mm Hg以上低下の独立予測因子: aTRH（OR 1.56; 95% CI 1.08-2.25）、ベースラインeGFRが高いこと（OR 1.15 per 10 mL/min/1.73 m2; 95% CI 1.05-1.26）。利尿薬使用およびアルブミン尿は予測因子でなかった。aTRH効果は治療非依存（interaction P = 0.21）。有害事象: aTRH群 63.8% vs 非aTRH群 51.1%。併用療法時の高カリウム血症: aTRH群 11.2% vs 非aTRH群 17.5%。併用療法は単独療法より収縮期血圧を大きく低下させた（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。

items.title: Butyrate enhances the obesity reduction effect of Semaglutide.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Obesity represents a global public health burden with continuously increasing prevalence over recent decades. Combination regimens pairing semaglutide (Sema) with additional therapeutic agents have emerged as a major focus for anti-obesity research.
METHODS: In diet-induced obese (DIO) mice, we evaluated whether oxytocin (Oxt, 3 and 5 mg·kg-1), long-acting oxytocin (la‑Oxt), caffeine, or butyrate could potentiate the anti-obesity efficacy of Sema. We further compared hypothalamic neuronal activity and plasma metabolomic profiles following Sema treatment against dietary restriction (DR), an established intervention for weight loss and metabolic improvement.
RESULTS: Whereas Oxt, la‑Oxt, and caffeine did not augment Sema-mediated body weight reduction, butyrate produced significant potentiation of Sema's anti-obesity effects. Either Sema monotherapy or Sema-butyrate co-administration elevated the number of c-Fos-positive cells in the paraventricular nucleus (PVN) of the hypothalamus. By contrast, DR decreased PVN c-Fos-positive cell number. Butyrate amplified Sema-elicited activation of PVN neuronal activity. Plasma metabolomics revealed limited overlap between the pharmacological interventions and DR, demonstrating orthogonal metabolic responses.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings identify the Sema-butyrate combination as a promising anti-obesity strategy, and demonstrate that Sema and DR exert divergent effects on both hypothalamic neuronal activity and plasma metabolite levels.
items.authors: Huang Ying, Gu Kaiyue, Li Chaonan, Cheng Jie, Liu Mengmeng, Zhang Guo
items.summary_ja: 食事誘発性肥満（DIO）マウスを用い、セマグルチド（Sema）の抗肥満効果にオキシトシン（Oxt, 3および5 mg/kg）、長作用型オキシトシン（la-Oxt）、カフェイン、酪酸（butyrate）が相乗的に作用するかを評価した。さらに、Sema投与と食事制限（DR）による視床下部神経活動および血漿メタボロームプロファイルの比較も行われた。Oxt、la-Oxt、カフェインはSemaによる体重減少を増強しなかったが、酪酸はSemaの抗肥満効果を有意に増強した。Sema単独投与およびSema-酪酸併用投与は視床傍核（PVN）のc-Fos陽性細胞数を増加させたが、DRは減少させた。酪酸はSema誘発のPVN神経活動を増幅した。血漿メタボローム解析では、薬理学的介入とDRの間には限られた重複のみが認められ、直交的な代謝応答を示した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 酪酸はセマグルチドの抗肥満効果を有意に増強し、Sema-酪酸併用は有望な抗肥満戦略である。また、Semaと食事制限は視床下部神経活動および血漿代謝物レベルに対して異なる効果を示す。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満は近年の増加傾向が続く世界的な公衆衛生上の負担であり、セマグルチドと追加治療薬を組み合わせる併用療法は抗肥満研究の主要な焦点となっている。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床（動物実験）研究：食事誘発性肥満（DIO）マウスを用いた薬理学的介入およびメカニズム解明研究
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少（抗肥満効果）、視床傍核（PVN）のc-Fos陽性細胞数、血漿メタボロームプロファイル

items.title: SEMAGLUTIDE TREATMENT IN TWO VERY YOUNG CHILDREN WITH SEVERE EARLY-ONSET OBESITY.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Monogenic obesity comprises a group of rare genetic disorders characterized by severe early-onset obesity and hyperphagia. Pharmacological treatment options for severe early-onset obesity remain limited, particularly in young children.
CASE PRESENTATION: We report two children younger than 6 years of age with severe early-onset obesity, including one with genetically confirmed monogenic obesity, who showed reductions in BMI-SDS during semaglutide treatment. Case-1: A 4.5-year-old girl with a homozygous ADCY3 (c.1102G>A) variant presented with severe obesity, hyperphagia, hypertension, hepatosteatosis and Blount's disease. Baseline BMI was 48.0 kg/m2 (+5.5 SDS). Semaglutide was initiated at 0.125 mg/week and titrated to 1.5 mg/week. After 18 months, BMI-SDS decreased from +5.5 to +4.1 (-25.5%), accompanied by improved in hyperphagia and resolution of left ventricular hypertrophy. No significant adverse effects were observed, and linear growth remained age appropriate. Case-2: A 3.3-year-old boy with hyperphagia, severe obesity and dyslipidaemia was diagnosed with Klinefelter syndrome (47,XXY). Clinical Exome Sequencing identified no causative variant for obesity. Baseline BMI was 32.6 kg/m2 (+5.7 SDS). Semaglutide was initiated at 0.0625 mg/week and gradually titrated to 2.0 mg/week. After 21 months, BMI-SDS decreased from +5.7 to +4.4 (-22%). Treatment was generally well tolerated, with normal linear growth.
CONCLUSION: This two cases describe reductions BMI-SDS during semaglutide treatment in very young children with severe early-onset obesity, including one child with genetically confirmed ADCY3-related monogenic obesity. These findings suggest a potential clinical benefit of semaglutide in this young population, warranting evaluation in larger studies.
items.authors: Canbaz Aylin Tugba, Kahveci Ahmet, Kurt Ilknur, Demir Senol, Geçkinli Bilgen Bilge, Bereket Abdullah, Haliloglu Belma
items.summary_ja: 6歳未満の重度の早期発症肥満を有する2児（うち1児は遺伝的に確認されたADCY3関連単一遺伝子肥満）において、セマグルチド治療中にBMI-SDSの低下が観察された症例報告。Case-1は4.5歳の女児（ADCY3ホモ接合変異）、Case-2は3.3歳の男児（Klinefelter症候群、肥満原因変異なし）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 非常に幼い重度の早期発症肥満児（6歳未満）においてセマグルチド治療によりBMI-SDSの有意な低下が観察され、この年齢層での潜在的な臨床的有用性を示唆する。
items.why_matters_ja: 重度の早期発症肥満、特に幼い小児における薬物治療選択肢は限られており、本症例報告はセマグルチドがこの年齢層で有効かつ忍容性良好である可能性を示し、より大規模な研究での評価を要する。
items.study_type_ja: 症例報告（2例）
items.endpoints_ja: BMI-SDSの変化、過食の改善、左室肥大の消退、線形成長、有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: Case-1: BMI-SDS +5.5 → +4.1（-25.5%）、18ヶ月後。過食の改善、左室肥大の消退。有意な有害事象なし。線形成長は年齢相応。Case-2: BMI-SDS +5.7 → +4.4（-22%）、21ヶ月後。治療は概ね忍容性良好。線形成長は正常。

items.title: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor-associated euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis in an adolescent with type 2 diabetes.
items.abstract: Youth-onset type 2 diabetes (T2D) is increasing, prompting expanded use of pharmacotherapies previously approved only for adults. Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors, approved for pediatric use in 2023, improve glycemic control by promoting glucosuria, but they carry a known risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) in adults. We describe a unique pediatric case of SGLT2 inhibitor-associated euglycemic DKA in a 12-year-old female with T2D. The patient developed DKA with normal glucose shortly after initiating an SGLT2 inhibitor, leading to diagnostic uncertainty and recognition only after exclusion of more common etiologies. She was successfully treated with intravenous insulin and fluids with resolution of DKA and subsequently transitioned to subcutaneous insulin therapy. This case underscores that euglycemic DKA can occur in youth receiving SGLT2 inhibitors, particularly during puberty when physiologic insulin resistance may heighten risk, and that subtle presentations can complicate early recognition if clinicians rely on hyperglycemia alone. As SGLT2 inhibitors enter broader pediatric use, heightened diagnostic vigilance, guided assessment of ketones and acid-base status in symptomatic patients, and patient and family education are essential to ensure safe use in children and adolescents with T2D.
items.authors: Segev Natalie, Brady Ryan P, Dolan Lawrence, Shah Amy S
items.summary_ja: 12歳の女性2型糖尿病患者がSGLT2阻害薬開始直後に正常血糖下で糖尿病性ケトアシドーシス（euglycemic DKA）を発症した単例報告である。より一般的な病因の除外後に診断され、静脈内インスリンと輸液でDKAは解決し、その後皮下インスリン療法に移行した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬を投与中の青少年でもeuglycemic DKAが発生し得る。特に思春期には生理学的インスリン抵抗性によりリスクが高まる可能性があり、高血糖のみを診断基準に頼ると早期認識が困難になる。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の小児・青少年への使用が拡大する中、症状のある患者に対するケトン体と酸塩基状態の評価、および患者・家族への教育が安全な使用に不可欠である。
