items.title: Antidiabetic medications in the pipeline.
items.abstract: There is an extensive pipeline of therapies for diabetes mellitus. It has been known for the past three decades that obesity is a key pathophysiological player, involving inflammation, insulin resistance and metabolic dysfunction leading to type 2 diabetes and to significant cardiovascular, renal and hepatic complications, all central to the metabolic syndrome. On the basis of this knowledge and the disposition of drugs with multiple effects on different disease components, the diabetes therapeutic paradigm has shifted from merely glucocentric to multitargeted against these interconnected pathways.Much more recently, incretin-based multi-agonists have been developed that deliver unprecedented glycemic and weight benefits as well as weekly insulins and oral GLP-1 agonists that are able to reduce the burden of injectable therapies. An antibody-peptide conjugate that acts as a dual GLP-1/GIP receptor modulator has also shown promising results. Today, novel insulin sensitizers are modulating metabolic pathways towards higher energy expenditure with fewer side effects. Adjunctive agents for type 1 diabetes are improving glucose control while reducing hypoglycemia risk. Finally, drugs designed to restrain the inevitable muscle mass loss caused by antiobesity treatments are being tested. The diabetes pipeline is rich and there is hope that in the next few years, the therapeutic landscape will be further transformed with even more efficacious and individualized treatments.
items.authors: Efstathiadou Zoe A, Gogakos Apostolos I, Divaris Efstathios, Kostopoulos Georgios, Makri Evangelia
items.summary_ja: 糖尿病治療薬のパイプラインに関するレビュー論文。肥満が炎症・インスリン抵抗性・代謝異常を介して2型糖尿病および心血管・腎・肝臓合併症を引き起こす主要な病生理学的因子であることが30年以上前から知られており、この知見に基づき糖尿病治療のパラダイムは単なるグルコース中心から、相互に関連する経路に対するマルチターゲットアプローチへと移行した。インクリン系マルチアゴニスト、週1回インスリン、経口GLP-1アゴニスト、GLP-1/GIP受容体二重モジュレーターである抗体-ペプチド融合体、新規インスリン感受性改善薬、1型糖尿病の補助療法、抗肥満治療に伴う筋量減少を抑制する薬剤などが開発されている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 糖尿病治療のパイプラインは豊富であり、グルコース中心からマルチターゲットアプローチへの転換が進んでおり、今後数年でより効果的で個別化された治療が実現する可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 糖尿病治療の方向性が単一の血糖値低下から、肥満・炎症・代謝異常を含む複数の病態経路を同時に標的とするマルチターゲット戦略へと転換しており、心血管・腎・肝臓合併症を含むメタボリックシンドローム全体へのアプローチが期待される。

items.title: Economic evaluation of tirzepatide, semaglutide, and liraglutide in the treatment of obese and overweight patients without diabetes: a short-term cost-effectiveness analysis in Iran.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: GLP-1 and dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists have improved obesity treatment, but their high cost requires economic evaluation to guide resource allocation. To assess the short-term cost-effectiveness of subcutaneous tirzepatide, semaglutide, and liraglutide for treating adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes in Iran.
METHODS: A decision-tree model was developed to compare tirzepatide, semaglutide, and liraglutide over 68 weeks in adults aged ≥ 18 years with BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² or ≥ 27 kg/m² with at least one additional weight-related complication, excluding those with diabetes, from the payer perspective. Clinical effectiveness, adverse event (AE), and treatment discontinuation data were obtained from published literatures. Quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) were estimated based on BMI changes and AE-related disutility. Direct medical costs included drug acquisition and AE management costs. Deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses were performed.
RESULTS: Compared with semaglutide, tirzepatide generated greater health benefits but at higher costs, resulting in an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio of US$34,423.89/QALY. Liraglutide was dominated by semaglutide. Semaglutide was cost-effective at the Iranian willingness-to-pay threshold of US$ (Purchasing power parity (PPP) 15,558.5/QALY, equal to one time GDP per capita in 2026. Sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of the findings.
CONCLUSION: Semaglutide was the cost-effective injectable GLP-1-based therapy in Iran. Although tirzepatide provided greater health benefits, its higher cost limited its cost-effectiveness at current prices.
SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40200-026-02114-z.

items.summary_ja: イランにおいて、糖尿病を伴わない過体重・肥満成人に対する皮下注射製剤（tirzepatide、semaglutide、liraglutide）の短期（68週間）コスト効果分析を、ペイヤー視点から決定木モデルを用いて実施した。臨床効果、有害事象、治療中断データは公開文献から取得し、QALYはBMI変化とAE関連のディスユーティリティに基づいて推定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SemaglutideはイランのWTP閾値（US$15,558.5/QALY、PPP、2026年1人当たりGDPの1倍）においてコスト効果があった。Tirzepatideはsemaglutideより健康利益が大きいが高コストであり、ICERはUS$34,423.89/QALYであった。Liraglutideはsemaglutideに支配された。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGLP-1/GIP二重受容体作動薬は肥満治療を改善しているが、その高コストにより資源配分を導くための経済評価が必要である。

items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：増分コスト効果比（ICER/QALY）。その他：QALY、直接医療コスト（薬剤取得費＋AE管理費）、WTP閾値におけるコスト効果の判定。
items.endpoint_results_ja: Tirzepatide vs semaglutideのICER：US$34,423.89/QALY。Liraglutideはsemaglutideに支配された。SemaglutideはイランのWTP閾値（US$15,558.5/QALY、PPP、2026年1人当たりGDPの1倍）においてコスト効果があった。

items.title: Dapagliflozin alleviates CYH33-induced hyperglycemia and preserves antitumor immunity against ovarian cancer in type 1 diabetic mice.
items.abstract: PI3K is frequently hyperactivated in ovarian cancer and has emerged as a promising therapeutic target. CYH33 is a novel PI3Kα-selective inhibitor that has been approved in Japan for the treatment of ovarian clear cell carcinoma harboring PIK3CA mutations. However, its on-target adverse effect of hyperglycemia limits its clinical application, particularly in patients susceptible to diabetes, underscoring the urgent need to optimize therapeutic strategies to improve both safety and efficacy. In this study, we employed an ID8 syngeneic murine ovarian cancer model and demonstrated that CYH33 significantly inhibited tumor growth with a modest effect on glucose homeostasis. We then established mouse models of type 1 (T1D) and type 2 diabetes (T2D) to expose hyperglycemia induced by PI3K inhibition and identified that dapagliflozin effectively alleviated CYH33-induced hyperglycemia while preserving its antitumor activity in T1D mice. Mechanistically, the combination of CYH33 and dapagliflozin may improve the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment in T1D mice, as evidenced by upregulation gene sets involved in interferon-α and interferon-γ response, as well as significantly enhanced infiltration of CD8+ T-cell in ID8 tumors. Furthermore, this combination synergized with anti-PD-1 antibody to further enhance antitumor efficacy. These findings provide a potential strategy for optimizing the clinical use of PI3K inhibitors and shed light on metabolic interventions to modulate tumor immune microenvironment.
items.authors: Sun Jiaqi, Xu Lan, Qu Hui, Zhang Xi, Ma Xiaoyu, Leng Ying, Meng Linghua
items.summary_ja: 本研究は、ID8同種マウス卵巣がんモデルを用い、PI3Kα選択的阻害薬CYH33が腫瘍増殖を有意に抑制し、血糖恒常性への影響は modest であることを示した。次に、1型糖尿病（T1D）および2型糖尿病（T2D）マウスモデルを確立し、PI3K阻害による高血糖を再現した。T1Dマウスにおいて、ダパグリフロジンがCYH33誘発性高血糖を効果的に軽減しつつ抗腫瘍活性を維持することを明らかにした。機能的には、CYH33とダパグリフロジンの併用がT1Dマウスの免疫抑制性腫瘍微小環境を改善し、インターフェロン-αおよびインターフェロン-γ応答関連遺伝子セットの上調とID8腫瘍におけるCD8+ T細胞浸潤の有意な増加が認められた。さらに、この併用は抗PD-1抗体と相乗的に抗腫瘍効果をさらに増強した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ダパグリフロジンは、1型糖尿病マウスにおいてCYH33誘発性高血糖を軽減しつつ抗腫瘍免疫を維持し、抗PD-1抗体との併用により抗腫瘍効果を相乗的に増強する。
items.why_matters_ja: CYH33は日本においてPIK3CA変異を有する卵巣明細胞癌の治療に承認されているが、高血糖というオンターゲット有害事象が臨床応用を制限している。本結果は、PI3K阻害薬の臨床使用を最適化し、代謝介入による腫瘍免疫微小環境の調節を示す新たな戦略を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床（マウスモデル）研究
items.endpoints_ja: 腫瘍増殖、血糖恒常性（高血糖）、腫瘍微小環境（インターフェロン-α/γ応答関連遺伝子セット、CD8+ T細胞浸潤）、抗腫瘍効果（抗PD-1抗体併用時）

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy and incident atrial fibrillation in non-diabetic adults with obesity and chronic kidney disease: a propensity matched cohort study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Obesity and chronic kidney disease (CKD) are potent risk factors for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet whether GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) prevent incident AF in non-diabetic adults with obesity and CKD is unexamined. We assessed whether GLP-1RA therapy reduces 1-year AF incidence in this cardiorenal phenotype.
METHODS: Using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network (66 healthcare organizations), we conducted a retrospective target trial emulation of non-diabetic adults aged 18 or older with obesity and CKD stages 3-5 diagnosed 2021-2024. Patients receiving semaglutide, liraglutide, or tirzepatide (n = 10,985) were compared with unexposed patients (n = 94,527). After propensity score matching, 7326 patients remained per cohort. The primary outcome was incident AF at 1 year; secondary outcomes included AF subtypes, ventricular tachyarrhythmias, and all-cause hospitalization. Cox models generated hazard ratios (HRs); sensitivity analyses extended follow-up to 2-3 years with landmark analyses.
RESULTS: At 1 year, GLP-1RA use was associated with significantly lower incident AF (1.63% vs. 2.62%; HR 0.655, 95% CI 0.508-0.844; p = 0.001), a 34.5% relative risk reduction. Reductions were consistent for paroxysmal (HR 0.586), persistent (HR 0.482), and longstanding persistent AF (HR 0.527; all p < 0.05); permanent AF was non-significant at 1 year. Ventricular tachyarrhythmias (HR 0.556; p = 0.002) and hospitalization (HR 0.668; p < 0.001) were also significantly reduced. Benefits persisted across 2- and 3-year follow-up and remained consistent in landmark analyses.
CONCLUSIONS: In non-diabetic adults with obesity and CKD, GLP-1RA therapy was associated with significant, durable reductions in incident AF, ventricular arrhythmias, and hospitalization. These findings are consistent with a possible cardiorenal benefit and support prioritizing this phenotype for dedicated randomized trials.
items.authors: Hassan Abdulraheem, Okorigba Efeturi, Grace Chilaka, Otabor Emmanuel, Osineye Busayo, Olayiwola Olalekan, Oyeleye Tutuola, Amin Parthiv
items.summary_ja: TriNetX US Collaborative Network（66医療機関）のデータを用いた後方視的ターゲットトライアルエミュレーション。2021〜2024年に診断された、肥満を伴うCKD 3〜5期の非糖尿病成人（18歳以上）において、GLP-1受容体作動薬（セマグルチド、リラグルチド、tirzepatide）が1年間の新規心房細動（AF）発生を抑制するかを評価した。傾向スコアマッチング後、コホートごとに7,326例が比較対象となった。主要アウトカムは1年時点の新規AF発生、副次アウトカムはAFサブタイプ、心室性頻拍性不整脈、全原因入院であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満を伴うCKDの非糖尿病成人において、GLP-1受容体作動薬の使用は1年時点の新規AF発生（HR 0.655）、心室性頻拍性不整脈（HR 0.556）、全原因入院（HR 0.668）の有意かつ持続的な減少と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満とCKDはAFの強力なリスク因子であるが、この心腎フェノタイプにおいてGLP-1受容体作動薬が新規AFを予防するかは未検証であった。本結果は、このフェノタイプに対する専用のランダム化試験を優先すべきことを支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的ターゲットトライアルエミュレーション（傾向スコアマッチングコホート研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：1年時点の新規心房細動（AF）発生。副次アウトカム：AFサブタイプ（発作性、持続性、長期持続性、恒常性）、心室性頻拍性不整脈、全原因入院。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 1年時点の新規AF：GLP-1RA群 1.63% vs 非暴露群 2.62%；HR 0.655, 95% CI 0.508-0.844; p = 0.001。発作性AF：HR 0.586。持続性AF：HR 0.482。長期持続性AF：HR 0.527（いずれもp < 0.05）。恒常性AF：1年時点で有意差なし。心室性頻拍性不整脈：HR 0.556; p = 0.002。全原因入院：HR 0.668; p < 0.001。

items.title: Periconceptional and early-pregnancy exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors and congenital malformations: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are increasingly prescribed to women of reproductive age for type 2 diabetes and cardiorenal protection, and are commonly continued through the periconceptional period until pregnancy is recognized. Human safety data on inadvertent first-trimester exposure remain scarce, creating substantial clinical uncertainty.
METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and CENTRAL from inception to 15 May 2026 for observational cohort studies comparing early-pregnancy or preconception exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors with active antidiabetic comparators among women with type 2 diabetes. Adjusted risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using random-effects meta-analysis.
RESULTS: Three cohorts, including 669 SGLT2 inhibitor-exposed pregnancies, were eligible. In the prespecified insulin-comparator analysis, SGLT2 inhibitor exposure was not associated with major congenital malformations (RR 0.94, 95% CI 0.68-1.29) or cardiac malformations (RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.64-1.48). The inclusion of a preconception sulfonylurea comparator cohort yielded a similar estimate for major congenital malformations (RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.74-1.29). In a Korean cohort, exposure during gestational weeks 4-10 was associated with congenital heart defects (RR 2.79, 95% CI 1.16-7.06).
CONCLUSIONS: Based on the limited observational evidence available, early SGLT2 inhibitor exposure was not associated with an increased risk of overall major congenital or cardiac malformations; however, the estimates were imprecise and could not rule out clinically important increases in risk. Certainty of the evidence was low to very low because of residual confounding, live-birth selection, heterogeneous exposure definitions, and few exposed events. A possible timing-specific cardiac signal requires replication.
items.authors: Dutta Deep, Mahajan Kunal, Gupta Gunjan, Sharma Meha, Sugandha Swati, Kamrul-Hasan A B M
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の周産期・妊娠初期曝露と先天奇形との関連を評価した系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシス。観察コホート研究3件（SGLT2阻害薬曝露妊娠669例）が対象となった。インスリン比較群の事前指定解析では、主要先天奇形（RR 0.94, 95% CI 0.68-1.29）および心奇形（RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.64-1.48）との関連は認められなかった。スルホニルウレア比較群を含む解析でも主要先天奇形の推定値は類似（RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.74-1.29）。一方、韓国コホートでは妊娠4〜10週での曝露が先天性心疾患と関連（RR 2.79, 95% CI 1.16-7.06）した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 限られた観察疫学的証拠に基づき、SGLT2阻害薬の早期曝露は全体的な主要先天奇形や心奇形のリスク増加とは関連しなかったが、推定値は不正確であり、臨床的に重要なリスク増加を排除できなかった。時期特異的な心臓シグナルの再現性が求められる。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は生殖年齢の女性に2型糖尿病や心腎保護目的で増加傾向にあり、妊娠が判明するまで周産期に継続されることが多い。意図しない第1三半期曝露に関するヒト安全性データは依然として乏しく、臨床的不確実性が大きい。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシス（観察コホート研究を対象）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要先天奇形、心奇形、先天性心疾患（妊娠4〜10週曝露の時期特異的解析）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要先天奇形（インスリン比較群）: RR 0.94, 95% CI 0.68-1.29 / 心奇形（インスリン比較群）: RR 0.97, 95% CI 0.64-1.48 / 主要先天奇形（スルホニルウレア比較群を含む）: RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.74-1.29 / 先天性心疾患（韓国コホート、妊娠4〜10週曝露）: RR 2.79, 95% CI 1.16-7.06

items.title: Dapagliflozin in phenotypically stratified HFpEF without myocardial fibrosis: the STADIA-HFpEF randomized crossover trial.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction(HFpEF) is characterized by increased diastolic left ventricular(LV) stiffness resulting from variable contributions of myocardial extracellular matrix(ECM) remodeling and titin-based cardiomyocyte stiffness. Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors(SGLT2i) improved cardiomyocyte distensibility, inflammation, and oxidative stress in experimental and human HFpEF myocardium. We investigated whether dapagliflozin improves LV distensibility in phenotypically stratified HFpEF patients without significant myocardial fibrosis.
METHODS: STADIA-HFpEF was a 34-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial. HFpEF patients underwent multi-level phenotypic stratification including cardiac magnetic resonance imaging to exclude structural cardiomyopathies and significant myocardial ECM remodeling. Participants were randomized to dapagliflozin 10 mg or placebo for two 13-week treatment periods separated by an 8-week washout.The co-primary endpoints were changes in E/e'/LV end-diastolic volume index(LVEDVi) and mean LV e', reflecting LV distensibility and relaxation. Secondary endpoints included echocardiographic variables, quality of life, 6-minute walk distance, and inflammatory biomarkers.
RESULTS: Between February 2020 and October 2022, 32 patients were randomized and 29 completed the study protocol. Median age was 73(68-76) years including 28 women(88%). Dapagliflozin did not significantly modify E/e'/LVEDVi compared with placebo 0.24 (0.20-0.32) to 0.26 (0.22-0.34) vs. 0.23 (0.22-0.29) to 0.25 (0.21-0.31); p=0.370 nor did it change mean LV e' 6.2 (5.6-7.5) to 6.2 (5.7-7.1) vs. 6.6 (5.6-7.4) to 6.7 (5.4-7.5); p=0.448. Most secondary outcomes were neutral. However, an isolated improvement in LA conduit strain and numerical reductions in inflammatory biomarkers were observed during dapagliflozin treatment.
CONCLUSIONS: In phenotypically stratified HFpEF patients without significant myocardial fibrosis, dapagliflozin did not improve LV distensibility or relaxation. An isolated improvement in LA conduit strain and numerical reductions in inflammatory biomarkers were observed; however, these exploratory findings require confirmation in larger studies.
items.authors: Scheffer Mariëlle, van Maarschalkerwaart Willemijn, Dong Chaohui, Landzaat Jochem W D, Nedenyi Fanni, Delalat Simin, Sultana Innas, Jarkas Oliver
items.summary_ja: STADIA-HFpEFは、心筋線維化が有意でない表現型層別化されたHFpEF患者において、ダパグリフロジンが左室(LV)拡張性を改善するかを評価した34週間のランダム化二重盲検プラセボ対照クロスオーバー試験である。32例がランダム化され、29例がプロトコルを完了した（中央年齢73歳、女性88%）。共同一次エンドポイントであるE/e'/LVEDViの変化および平均LV e'の変化はいずれも有意な改善を認めなかった。二次エンドポイントの多くは中立であったが、LA conduit strainの孤立した改善と炎症性バイオマーカーの数値的減少が観察された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 心筋線維化が有意でない表現型層別化されたHFpEF患者において、ダパグリフロジンはLV拡張性（E/e'/LVEDVi）や弛緩（平均LV e'）を有意に改善しなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: HFpEFは心筋細胞外基質(ECM)リモデリングとチチンベースの心筋細胞剛性の異なる寄与によって特徴づけられ、SGLT2iが心筋細胞の伸展性を改善する可能性が実験的・臨床的に示唆されていた。本試験は、線維化を除外したHFpEFサブグループにおいてSGLT2iのLV拡張性への効果を層別化して評価した点で意義があるが、主要エンドポイントでは効果が確認されず、SGLT2iのHFpEFにおける作用機序は線維化の有無や表現型によって異なる可能性を示唆している。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化二重盲検プラセボ対照クロスオーバー試験
items.endpoints_ja: 共同一次エンドポイント：E/e'/LVEDViの変化、平均LV e'の変化。二次エンドポイント：エコー心図変数、生活の質(QOL)、6分歩行距離、炎症性バイオマーカー。
items.endpoint_results_ja: E/e'/LVEDVi：ダパグリフロジン群 0.24 (0.20-0.32) → 0.26 (0.22-0.34) vs プラセボ群 0.23 (0.22-0.29) → 0.25 (0.21-0.31)；p=0.370。平均LV e'：ダパグリフロジン群 6.2 (5.6-7.5) → 6.2 (5.7-7.1) vs プラセボ群 6.6 (5.6-7.4) → 6.7 (5.4-7.5)；p=0.448。LA conduit strain：孤立した改善（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。炎症性バイオマーカー：数値的減少（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。
items.sample_size_ja: 32例がランダム化、29例がプロトコルを完了

items.title: Diagnostic challenges of masked arginine vasopressin deficiency in neurosarcoidosis complicated by sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor use.
items.abstract: A wide variety of endocrine disorders caused by sarcoidosis have been reported to date. We report the case of an 82-year-old male patient who presented with hypercalcemia and anterior pituitary hormone deficiency at the time of his sarcoidosis diagnosis and was subsequently diagnosed with arginine vasopressin deficiency (AVP-D) 6 months after the initiation of glucocorticoid therapy. Magnetic resonance imaging revealed an enlarged pituitary gland, thickened pituitary stalk, and loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot, raising the suspicion of hypothalamic-pituitary sarcoidosis. Despite improvement in hypercalcemia, anterior pituitary function, and pituitary enlargement and stalk thickening with glucocorticoid therapy, subjective symptoms of dry mouth and polyuria gradually became apparent several months after the start of treatment. While the characteristic hypotonic polyuria of AVP-D was not prominent, we surmised that these typical clinical features were masked by adrenal insufficiency, chronic kidney disease (CKD), and concurrent use of a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor for type 2 diabetes. This case highlights the fact that the typical presentation of AVP-D can be masked by concurrent SGLT2 inhibitor use and CKD, emphasizing careful assessment of water balance in such patients.
items.authors: Nonaka Ryohei, Tanaka Katsuhiro, Tomimoto Akemi, Nagai Yukie, Nomura Takuya, Shibata Hirotaka
items.summary_ja: 82歳男性の神経サルコイドーシス症例。サルコイドーシス診断時に高カルシウム血症と前葉ホルモン欠損を認め、グルココルチコイド療法開始6か月後にアルギニンバソプレシン欠損（AVP-D）と診断された。MRIで下垂体肥大、下垂体茎肥厚、後葉高信号消失を認めた。グルココルチコイド療法により高カルシウム血症・前葉機能・下垂体肥大は改善したが、数か月後に口渇と多尿が徐々に出現した。AVP-Dに特徴的な低浸透圧性多尿は顕著でなく、副腎不全、慢性腎臓病（CKD）、および2型糖尿病に対するSGLT2阻害薬の併用により典型的な臨床所見がマスクされていたと推測された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の併用とCKDによりAVP-Dの典型的な臨床所見（低浸透圧性多尿）がマスクされうるため、こうした患者では水分バランスの慎重な評価が重要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 神経サルコイドーシスに伴うAVP-Dは、SGLT2阻害薬やCKDなどの併存疾患・薬剤により診断が困難になり得る。本症例は、これらの要因がAVP-Dの典型的な臨床像を隠蔽し、診断を遅らせる可能性を示しており、臨床現場での水分バランス評価の重要性を強調している。

items.title: Qualitative Exit Interviews to Characterize the Positive Treatment Experiences of Patients in the Phase III Trial of Orforglipron Versus Oral Semaglutide for the Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: There is an unmet need for effective and well-tolerated oral formulations of glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists for the management of type 2 diabetes. Orforglipron and oral semaglutide are two oral glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists evaluated in the ACHIEVE-3 clinical trial (NCT06045221). These novel treatments have the means to achieve clinically meaningful glycemic control and weight reduction, which may result in substantial positive changes in patients' daily lives. The objective of this study was to conduct exit interviews following the ACHIEVE-3 trial to characterize positive treatment experiences and outcomes, beyond glycated hemoglobin and weight reduction, reported by patients living with type 2 diabetes who received oral glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist-based treatments.
METHODS: Qualitative interviews were conducted across ten clinical sites within the USA with patients who had enrolled in ACHIEVE-3 and completed at least 3 months of treatment. Interviews were conducted in English or Spanish, audio-recorded, and transcribed. Transcripts were analyzed to identify and categorize positive treatment benefits reported during the interviews. Descriptive statistics were used to characterize the sample.
RESULTS: Sixty patients completed the qualitative exit interviews. Patients had a mean age of 59.1 years (standard deviation [SD] = 10.3), and almost half were female (n = 28, 46.7%). Patients had been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes for a mean of 8.5 years (SD = 5.7). By the end of the study, patients reduced their glycated hemoglobin by 1.6% (SD = 1.3) from a baseline of 8.3% and lost a mean of 4.7 kg (SD = 6.8) from a baseline of 96.0 kg. All patients reported being satisfied with the trial medication (n = 59/59), were likely to recommend the treatment to other patients, and all but one were willing to continue taking the medication. As expected, the two most important and most frequently reported positive changes were controlled glycated hemoglobin (n = 53, 88.3%) and weight reduction (n = 50, 83.3%). Other common spontaneously reported positive concepts included increased perceived energy (n = 28, 46.7%), reduced appetite and cravings (n = 23, 38.3%), improved exercise/movement (n = 18, 30.0%), and psychological improvements (n = 18, 30.0%). Additional positive changes included increased confidence/self-esteem, improved diet and eating habits, improved sleep, and improved or a lack of deterioration in vision. All reported positive changes were considered meaningful by patients.
CONCLUSIONS: The current study explored the positive experiences of patients taking an oral glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist in the ACHIEVE-3 trial beyond traditional clinical benefits, such as glycemic control and weight reduction. The positive changes identified may be suitable targets for future clinical trial clinical outcome assessment endpoint strategies to help differentiate treatments and in clinical practices to classify patients' experiences.
items.authors: Boye Kristina, Cutts Katelyn, Zhao Youna, Steere Eliza, Gelhorn Heather
items.summary_ja: ACHIEVE-3試験（NCT06045221、Orforglipron vs 経口Semaglutide、2型糖尿病のPhase III試験）に参加し、少なくとも3ヶ月の治療を完了した患者を対象に、米国10施設で定性退出インタビューを実施した。HbA1cおよび体重減少以外の、経口GLP-1受容体作動薬による治療のポジティブな体験とアウトカムを特徴づけることを目的とした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 最も頻繁に報告されたポジティブな変化はHbA1cのコントロール（n=53, 88.3%）と体重減少（n=50, 83.3%）であり、次いでエネルギー感の向上（n=28, 46.7%）、食欲・渇望の減少（n=23, 38.3%）、運動・活動の改善（n=18, 30.0%）、心理的改善（n=18, 30.0%）が報告された。全患者が試験薬に満足しており（n=59/59）、1名を除き継続服用を希望した。
items.why_matters_ja: 本研究で特定されたポジティブな変化は、将来の臨床試験における臨床アウトカムアセスメント（COA）エンドポイント戦略の適したターゲットとなりうる。治療の差別化や臨床実践における患者体験の分類に活用可能である。
items.study_type_ja: 定性研究（Phase III臨床試験ACHIEVE-3に併設された定性退出インタビュー研究）
items.endpoints_ja: HbA1cおよび体重減少以外のポジティブな治療体験・アウトカムの定性評価（HbA1cコントロール、体重減少、エネルギー感の向上、食欲・渇望の減少、運動・活動の改善、心理的改善、自信・自尊心の向上、食事・食事習慣の改善、睡眠の改善、視力の改善または悪化なし）

items.title: Real-world, digital-first delivery of GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy in women.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have demonstrated substantial weight reduction and cardiometabolic benefit in randomized trials; however, prospective implementation evidence from digital care models and female sex community populations remains limited. Here we report outcomes from an observational study of 8,127 women initiating GLP-1RA therapy (99.8% tirzepatide) through a structured digital program incorporating mandatory biochemical monitoring, weekly video-supported follow-up and clinician-guided dose titration in the UK. Mean weight reduction was 16.1 kg (95% confidence interval 15.9 to 16.2; P < 0.001), representing 15.5% of baseline weight; 83.1% achieved ≥10% and 22.4% achieved ≥20% weight loss, with consistent responses across age, baseline weight and socioeconomic strata. Among participants with paired biomarker data, mean glycated hemoglobin decreased by 3.3 mmol mol-1 (95% confidence interval 3.1 to 3.4; P < 0.001), normalizing in 84.5% of those with baseline diabetes-range values and 96.3% with prediabetes, and lipid parameters improved significantly (reductions in total cholesterol of 0.77 mmol l-1, low-density lipoprotein cholesterol of 0.61 mmol l-1 and triglycerides of 0.47 mmol l-1). Retention was 91.4% at 6 months, with no serious treatment-related adverse events. These findings support the feasibility of delivering structured, digitally enabled obesity pharmacotherapy at scale and provide prospective real-world implementation evidence for this care model. Interpretation is limited by the observational design, absence of a comparator group, self-pay population and 6-month follow-up.
items.authors: Deanfield John, Wong Jamie Lai Chun, Katsoulis Michail, Deanfield Emma, Thakkar Raj, Patel Riyaz, Joy Rachael, Noble Matthew
items.summary_ja: 英国において、構造化デジタルプログラム（必須の生化学的モニタリング、週次ビデオ支援フォローアップ、臨床医主導の用量調整）を通じてGLP-1受容体作動薬（99.8%がtirzepatide）治療を開始した8,127名の女性を対象とした観察研究。平均体重減少は16.1 kg（ベースライン体重の15.5%）であり、83.1%が10%以上、22.4%が20%以上の体重減少を達成した。HbA1cは平均3.3 mmol/mol低下し、糖尿病域のベースライン値を有した参加者の84.5%、糖尿病予備群の96.3%で正常化を達成した。脂質パラメータも有意に改善し、6ヶ月時の継続率は91.4%、重大な治療関連有害事象は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 構造化デジタルプログラムによるGLP-1受容体作動薬治療は、女性集団において大規模に実施可能であり、有意な体重減少と心代謝的改善をもたらす。
items.why_matters_ja: デジタルケアモデルおよび女性集団におけるGLP-1受容体作動薬治療のprospective実装証拠が限られていた中、本研究はデジタルファーストの肥満薬物療法を大規模に提供することの現実可能性を示し、このケアモデルに対するprospective実世界実装証拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 観察研究（prospective、実世界）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少量、体重減少率（≥10%、≥20%達成率）、HbA1c変化量、HbA1c正常化率、脂質パラメータ（総コレステロール、LDLコレステロール、トリグリセリド）の変化量、6ヶ月時継続率、重大な治療関連有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: 平均体重減少: 16.1 kg（95% CI 15.9〜16.2; P < 0.001）、ベースライン体重の15.5%。≥10%体重減少達成率: 83.1%。≥20%体重減少達成率: 22.4%。HbA1c平均低下: 3.3 mmol/mol（95% CI 3.1〜3.4; P < 0.001）。HbA1c正常化率: 糖尿病域ベースライン値で84.5%、糖尿病予備群で96.3%。総コレステロール低下: 0.77 mmol/l。LDLコレステロール低下: 0.61 mmol/l。トリグリセリド低下: 0.47 mmol/l。6ヶ月時継続率: 91.4%。重大な治療関連有害事象: なし。

items.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and cardiovascular outcomes in patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis receiving biologic therapy: A propensity score-matched cohort study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis have an increased risk of cardiovascular disease. Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors provide cardiovascular benefits, but their association with cardiovascular outcomes in patients with psoriasis remains insufficiently studied.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the global TriNetX research network. Patients older than 40 years with plaque psoriasis receiving biologic therapy were categorized according to SGLT2 inhibitor use. Propensity score matching was performed to balance demographic characteristics, cardiovascular risk factors, kidney disease, and concomitant antidiabetic medications.
RESULTS: After matching, 2,016 patients were included in each cohort. SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with a significantly lower incidence of acute myocardial infarction (HR, 0.601; 95%CI, 0.426-0.849), stroke (HR, 0.553; 95%CI, 0.381-0.804), heart failure (HR, 0.751; 95%CI, 0.581-0.970), peripheral artery disease (HR, 0.648; 95%CI, 0.470-0.894), and angina pectoris (HR, 0.601; 95%CI, 0.404-0.894). No significant association was observed for transient ischemic attack.
CONCLUSIONS: SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with favorable cardiovascular outcomes in patients with moderate-to-severe psoriasis receiving biologic therapy. These findings support further prospective investigation of SGLT2 inhibitors as a potential strategy for cardiovascular risk reduction in this population.
items.authors: Gotor-Rivera A, Hernández Sánchez J, Chamorro Jiménez E, García Rivera E, Ortiz Romero P L, Rivera-Diaz R
items.summary_ja: 中等症〜重症の乾癬（乾板状乾癬）で生物学的製剤治療を受けている患者において、SGLT2阻害薬の使用と心血管アウトカムの関連を、TriNetX研究ネットワークを用いた後方視コホート研究で検討した。プロパensity score matchingにより各コホート2,016例をマッチングし、SGLT2阻害薬使用群は急性心筋梗塞、脳卒中、心不全、末梢動脈疾患、狭心症の発症率が有意に低かった。一過性脳虚血発作には有意な関連は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 中等症〜重症の乾癬で生物学的製剤治療中の患者において、SGLT2阻害薬の使用は心血管アウトカムの改善と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: 中等症〜重症の乾癬患者は心血管疾患のリスクが上昇しており、SGLT2阻害薬がこの集団における心血管リスク低減の戦略となり得る可能性を示唆する。ただし、本結果は後方視研究であり、前向き研究での検証が今後の課題である。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（プロパensity score matching適用）
items.endpoints_ja: 急性心筋梗塞、脳卒中、心不全、末梢動脈疾患、狭心症、一過性脳虚血発作

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment and cardiovascular outcomes following aortic valve replacement: a nationwide observational study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: GLP-1 receptor agonists reduce major adverse cardiovascular events among patients with diabetes, overweight, and obesity. Whether these benefits extend to patients undergoing aortic valve replacement (AVR) for severe aortic stenosis (AS) remains unknown. Thus, we investigated the association between GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment and cardiovascular outcomes after AVR.
METHODS: Nationwide population-based cohort study including consecutive patients with severe AS undergoing TAVI or SAVR in Western Denmark between January, 2016 and April, 2022. Patients were followed until death, emigration, crossover, or end of follow up on May 12, 2026. Propensity score-matching was performed to balance confounding. The primary outcome was a composite of all-cause mortality, heart failure hospitalization, or aortic valve reoperation. Secondary outcomes included all-cause mortality, heart failure hospitalization, aortic valve reoperation, with analyses accounting for the competing risk of death.
RESULTS: Among 5259 eligible patients undergoing AVR, 292 propensity score-matched patients were included in the final analyses. During a mean follow up of 4.8±2.4 years, GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment was associated with a lower risk of the primary composite outcome compared with controls (HR 0.69, 95%CI 0.50-0.96, p=0.029). GLP-1 receptor agonist treatment was also associated with lower risk of all-cause mortality (HR 0.66, 95%CI 0.46-0.95, p=0.025). In competing risk analyses accounting for death, lower risks were observed for heart failure hospitalization (HR 0.67, 95%CI 0.48-0.93, p=0.018), and aortic valve reoperation (HR 0.69, 95%CI 0.49-0.98, p=0.037).
CONCLUSION: Treatment with GLP-1 receptor agonists was associated with lower risk of cardiovascular outcomes including mortality following AVR among patients with severe AS.
items.authors: Krasniqi Lytfi, Hamandi Mohanad, Mortensen Poul Erik, Nissen Henrik, Pellikka Patricia A, Borlaug Barry A, Gerke Oke, Haujir Amal
items.summary_ja: 重度大動脈弁狭窄症に対してTAVIまたはSAVRを受けた患者において、GLP-1受容体作動薬の心血管転帰への影響を、デンマーク西部の全国規模の人口ベースコホート研究（2016年1月〜2022年4月）で検討した。プロパティスコアマッチングにより交絡を調整し、平均4.8±2.4年の追跡期間で転帰を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の投与は、AVR後の主要複合転帰（全死因死亡、心不全入院、大動脈弁再手術）のリスク低下（HR 0.69, 95%CI 0.50-0.96, p=0.029）および全死因死亡のリスク低下（HR 0.66, 95%CI 0.46-0.95, p=0.025）と関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の心血管保護効果は糖尿病・肥満患者で確立されているが、重度ASに対するAVR後の患者への適用は不明であった。本研究は、AVR後の患者におけるGLP-1受容体作動薬の潜在的な心血管保護効果を示唆し、この集団での治療戦略の検討を促す。
items.study_type_ja: 全国規模の人口ベース観察コホート研究（プロパティスコアマッチング適用）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要転帰：全死因死亡、心不全入院、大動脈弁再手術の複合。二次転帰：全死因死亡、心不全入院、大動脈弁再手術（死亡の競合リスクを考慮した解析）。
items.sample_size_ja: 適格患者5259名中、プロパティスコアマッチングにより最終解析に292名を含む。

items.title: Pharmacy students' knowledge and attitudes regarding GLP-1 receptor agonist adverse effects in obesity management: a cross-sectional study.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are important therapeutic options for obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Despite their increasing use, safety concerns remain, and pharmacy students' knowledge of their adverse effects is unclear. This study evaluated pharmacy students' knowledge and attitudes regarding GLP-1 RA adverse effects in obesity management. A cross-sectional questionnaire-based study was conducted among undergraduate Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) students (1st-7th year) at Umm Al-Qura University, Saudi Arabia, between November and December 2025. A newly developed questionnaire, reviewed by two experts and pilot-tested among 10 students, assessed 17 knowledge and five attitude items covering indications, mechanisms, adverse effects, and clinical scenarios. Of 1,118 eligible students, 296 completed the survey (response rate: 26.5%). Descriptive statistics and multivariable regression analyses were performed using RStudio (version 2024.9.1.394). Among participants (63.9% male), the mean knowledge score was 7.6 ± 4.0/17. Most agreed that adverse effects significantly impact clinical use (59.4%) and supported further education on less common side effects (61.1%). Nausea was the most frequently recognized adverse effect (59.1%), whereas thyroid C-cell tumors observed in rodent studies (25.0%) and diabetic retinopathy complications (36.5%) were less commonly identified. Only 37.2% correctly recognized that hypoglycemia is uncommon with GLP-1 RA monotherapy. Higher knowledge scores were significantly associated with greater confidence in knowledge (OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.17; p < 0.001) and stronger endorsement of further education on less common side effects (OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.18; p < 0.001), whereas gender and academic year were not significant predictors of any attitude item. Pharmacy students demonstrated limited knowledge but generally positive attitudes regarding GLP-1 RA safety. These findings highlight the need to strengthen pharmacovigilance and evidence-based medication safety education within pharmacy curricula to improve clinical preparedness and patient counseling.
items.authors: Khojah Alaa A, Gazzaz Malaz J, Aldurdunji Mohammed M, Safiraldeen Ahmad E, Al-Qurashi Ibrahim R, Alhazmi Mohammad A, Abdalla Ashraf N, Alqurashi Roaya S
items.summary_ja: サウジアラビアのUmm Al-Qura大学にて、Pharm.D.学部学生（1〜7年次）を対象に、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）の肥満管理における有害事象に関する知識と態度を評価した横断的質問紙調査。2025年11〜12月に実施し、対象1,118名中296名が回答（回答率26.5%）。知識スコアは17項目、態度は5項目で構成。平均知識スコアは7.6 ± 4.0/17であった。最も多く認識された有害事象は悪心（59.1%）であり、甲状腺C細胞腫瘍（25.0%）や糖尿病性網膜症合併症（36.5%）は認識率が低かった。GLP-1 RA単独療法で低血糖は稀であること正しく認識したのは37.2%のみ。知識スコアが高いほど知識への自信（OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.17; p < 0.001）および稀な副作用に関する追加教育への支持（OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.18; p < 0.001）が有意に高かった。性別と学年は態度項目の有意な予測因子ではなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 薬学学生はGLP-1 RAの安全性に関して知識は限定的であるが、態度は概ね肯定的であった。
items.why_matters_ja: これらの結果は、臨床的準備と患者カウンセリングの向上のため、薬学カリキュラム内での薬物警戒（pharmacovigilance）およびエビデンスベースの薬剤安全性教育を強化する必要性を浮き彫りにしている。
items.study_type_ja: 横断的調査（質問紙ベース）
items.endpoints_ja: GLP-1 RA有害事象に関する知識スコア（17項目）、態度（5項目）、個別有害事象の認識率、知識スコアと態度項目との関連（多変量回帰分析）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 平均知識スコア: 7.6 ± 4.0/17。有害事象が臨床使用に有意に影響すると回答: 59.4%。稀な副作用に関する追加教育に賛成: 61.1%。悪心の認識率: 59.1%。甲状腺C細胞腫瘍の認識率: 25.0%。糖尿病性網膜症合併症の認識率: 36.5%。GLP-1 RA単独療法で低血糖は稀であることの認識率: 37.2%。知識スコアと知識への自信の関連: OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.17; p < 0.001。知識スコアと追加教育への支持の関連: OR = 1.11, 95% CI: 1.06-1.18; p < 0.001。性別・学年は有意な予測因子ではなかった。

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist use and contrast-associated acute kidney injury after contrast-enhanced CT and CT angiography in adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease: a propensity score-matched cohort study.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To examine whether glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) use is associated with contrast-associated acute kidney injury (CA-AKI) after contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CE-CT) or computed tomographic angiography (CTA) in adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease (CKD).
METHODS: We conducted a TriNetX retrospective cohort study of adults with type 2 diabetes and CKD who underwent CE-CT or CTA from January 2020 to January 2025. GLP-1 RA use was defined by a prescription within six months before imaging. The primary outcome was a new acute kidney injury diagnosis within three days. Separate 1:1 propensity score-matched analyses were conducted for CE-CT and CTA, with eGFR-stratified and sensitivity analyses.
RESULTS: After matching, the CE-CT and CTA cohorts included 6,995 and 3,285 pairs, respectively. CA-AKI occurred in 3.8% of GLP-1 RA users versus 4.5% of non-users after CE-CT (odds ratio [OR] 0.84, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.71-0.99) and in 4.5% versus 6.1% after CTA (OR 0.74, 95% CI 0.59-0.92). The absolute risk differences were 0.7% points and 1.5% points, respectively. HbA1c remained imbalanced after matching. Negative-control outcomes were null, and eGFR-stratified associations were inconsistent between cohorts.
CONCLUSIONS: GLP-1 RA use was associated with a lower observed risk of CA-AKI after CE-CT and CTA in adults with type 2 diabetes and CKD. Residual HbA1c imbalance and the observational design limit causal interpretation; prospective studies using creatinine-based outcomes are needed.
items.authors: Chang Yu, Chi Kuan-Yu, Lin Hong-Min
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病および慢性腎臓病（CKD）を有する成人において、造影増強CT（CE-CT）またはCT血管造影（CTA）施行後の造影剤関連急性腎障害（CA-AKI）とGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）使用との関連を評価したTriNetXを用いた後方視コホート研究である。2020年1月から2025年1月までにCE-CTまたはCTAを施行した対象者を対象とし、画像検査の6か月前の処方に基づきGLP-1 RA使用を定義した。主評価項目は3日以内の新規急性腎障害診断であり、CE-CTとCTAそれぞれについて1:1プロパensityスコアマッチング解析を実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 2型糖尿病およびCKDを有する成人において、GLP-1 RA使用はCE-CTおよびCTA施行後のCA-AKIの観察リスク低下と関連していた。ただし、HbA1cの残存不均衡と観察研究デザインのため因果解釈には限界がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病およびCKDを有する患者は造影剤関連急性腎障害のリスクが高く、GLP-1 RAはこの集団で広く使用されている。造影検査の適応判断や腎保護戦略の策定において、GLP-1 RA使用とCA-AKIリスクの関連を把握することは臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（プロパensityスコアマッチング）
items.endpoints_ja: 主評価項目：CE-CTまたはCTA施行後3日以内の新規急性腎障害診断（CA-AKI）
items.endpoint_results_ja: CE-CT：CA-AKI発生率 GLP-1 RA使用者 3.8% vs 非使用者 4.5%（OR 0.84, 95% CI 0.71-0.99）、絶対リスク差 0.7%ポイント。CTA：CA-AKI発生率 GLP-1 RA使用者 4.5% vs 非使用者 6.1%（OR 0.74, 95% CI 0.59-0.92）、絶対リスク差 1.5%ポイント。

items.title: Recurrent In-Stent Restenosis and Accelerated Neoatherosclerosis in a Middle-Aged Woman With High Inflammatory Burden.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Recurrent in-stent restenosis (ISR) driven by accelerated neoatherosclerosis and high residual inflammatory risk remains a formidable clinical challenge.
CASE SUMMARY: A 50-year-old noncompliant, obese, diabetic woman presented with recurrent multivessel ISR. Intravascular ultrasound confirmed intrastent thin-cap fibroatheromas. Despite multiple drug-coated balloon interventions, intensive lipid-lowering via inclisiran, and glycemic control with tirzepatide, she suffered relentless ISR driven by highly elevated interleukin-6. She received advanced anti-inflammatory therapies and was referred for bypass surgery.
DISCUSSION: Literature highlights that targeting upstream inflammation is critical when standard therapies fail to halt malignant neoatherosclerosis. This case interests readers by demonstrating compliance optimization via long-acting agents and navigating advanced anti-inflammatory pathways (colchicine escalation, canakinumab) for refractory ISR.
TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Biomarkers like interleukin-6 must be evaluated in refractory ISR; persistent residual inflammation warrants advanced anti-inflammatory therapies or early surgical revascularization.
items.authors: Li Wenhao, Han Wenqi, Wang Zhenyu
items.summary_ja: 50歳の非服薬遵守・肥満・糖尿病を有する女性で、加速性新動脈硬化症および高炎症負荷（IL-6高値）に起因する反復性多血管内ステント内再狭窄（ISR）を呈した。複数回の薬剤洗脱バルーン介入、インクリシランによる集学的脂質低下療法、チルゼパチドによる血糖管理にもかかわらず、ISRは持続した。最終的に高度な抗炎症療法（コルヒチン増量、カナキヌマブ）を施行し、バイパス手術へ紹介された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 難治性ISRではIL-6などのバイオマーカーの評価が必須であり、持続する残存炎症に対しては高度な抗炎症療法または早期外科的血行再建が検討されるべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 標準療法で悪性新動脈硬化症を抑制できない場合、上流の炎症を標的とすることが重要である。本症例は、長作用薬剤による服薬遵守の最適化と、難治性ISRに対する高度な抗炎症経路（コルヒチン増量、カナキヌマブ）のナビゲーションを実証している。

items.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and Incident Cardiovascular Events and Death in Treated Serious Mental Illness, Type 2 Diabetes, and Obesity.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Adults with serious mental illness (SMI), type 2 diabetes, and obesity have elevated cardiovascular risk. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have established cardiometabolic benefits in the general population, but their effects in SMI are unclear. We evaluated whether GLP-1RA use was associated with lower risks of incident myocardial infarction (MI), heart failure (HF), and all-cause death.
METHODS: This was a retrospective propensity score-matched cohort study of 218 043 adults with SMI, type 2 diabetes, obesity, and active antipsychotic or antidepressant medications in the TriNetX database (73 health care organizations). Outcomes were incident MI, HF, and all-cause death at 1 and 3 years. The primary exposure was GLP-1RA use versus nonuse; secondary analyses examined semaglutide or tirzepatide. Exploratory analyses evaluated sex, race, and sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor and dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitor use.
RESULTS: GLP-1RA use was associated with lower risks of incident MI, HF, and all-cause death. Risk differences at 1 and 3 years were -0.007 and -0.010 for MI, -0.011 and -0.018 for HF, and -0.039 and -0.065 for death (all P<0.001). Semaglutide or tirzepatide use was also associated with lower risks of MI, HF, and death (all P<0.001). Findings were directionally consistent after accounting for sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor and dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitor use.
CONCLUSIONS: Adults with treated SMI, type 2 diabetes, and obesity using GLP-1RAs, particularly semaglutide or tirzepatide, had significantly reduced 1- and 3-year risks of incident MI, HF, and all-cause death versus nonusers. These pooled associations should be interpreted in the context of SMI's clinical heterogeneity and the limitations of administrative case ascertainment.

items.authors: Governor Samuel B, Dávila-García David M, Rivera-Segarra Eliut, Filiatreau Lindsey M, Tollinchi-Natali Nelmit, Essien Ekow, Altaee Osamah, Otchere Prince
items.summary_ja: TriNetXデータベース（73の医療機関）を用いた後方性プロパensityスコアマッチングコホート研究であり、重大な精神疾患（SMI）、2型糖尿病、肥満を有し、抗精神病薬または抗うつ薬を使用中の成人において、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）の使用が初発心筋梗塞（MI）、心不全（HF）、全死因死亡のリスク低下と関連するかを評価した。主要曝露はGLP-1RA使用 vs 非使用、二次解析ではセマグルチドまたはtirzepatideを検討した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 治療中のSMI、2型糖尿病、肥満を有する成人において、GLP-1RA（特にセマグルチドまたはtirzepatide）の使用は、非使用群と比較して1年および3年時の初発MI、HF、全死因死亡のリスクが有意に低かった。
items.why_matters_ja: SMI、2型糖尿病、肥満を有する成人は心血管リスクが上昇しており、GLP-1RAの一般集団における心代謝上の利点は確立されているが、SMIにおける効果は不明であった。本研究はSMI患者におけるGLP-1RAの心血管保護効果を示唆する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方性プロパensityスコアマッチングコホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: 1年および3年時の初発心筋梗塞（MI）、心不全（HF）、全死因死亡
items.endpoint_results_ja: リスク差（1年/3年）：MI -0.007 / -0.010、HF -0.011 / -0.018、全死因死亡 -0.039 / -0.065（いずれもP<0.001）。セマグルチドまたはtirzepatide使用もMI、HF、死亡のリスク低下と関連（いずれもP<0.001）。

items.title: Dapagliflozin After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation According to Frailty in DapaTAVI Trial.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Frailty is common in patients with severe aortic stenosis undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation and portends worse outcomes. Whether the benefit of posttranscatheter aortic valve implantation dapagliflozin differs by frailty is uncertain.
METHODS: In this post hoc analysis, we investigated the efficacy of dapagliflozin according to frailty status in the DapaTAVI (Dapagliflozin in Patients Undergoing Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation) trial. Frailty was assessed through the Fatigue, Resistance, Ambulation, Illnesses, and Loss of Weight scale (robust=0, prefrail=1-2, frail=3-5). The primary outcome was the composite of all-cause death or worsening heart failure at 1 year.
RESULTS: Among 1222 patients with baseline frailty assessment, 47.2% were frail, 40.3% prefrail, and 12.4% robust. Over 12 months, 215 patients (17.6%) experienced the primary end point. Patients who were prefrail and frail had higher risk than robust patients (adjusted hazard ratios [HRs], 1.88 [95% CI, 1.05-3.38] and 2.29 [1.29-4.07], respectively; P=0.004). Dapagliflozin was associated with a lower risk of the primary end point in patients who were frail (HR, 0.53 [95% CI, 0.36-0.77]) but not in those who were prefrail (HR, 1.01 [95% CI, 0.66-1.55]) or robust patients (HR, 1.26 [95% CI, 0.42-3.75]); P for interaction=0.021. There was no evidence that frailty modified the safety profile of dapagliflozin.
CONCLUSIONS: Frailty was common and independently associated with worse outcomes after transcatheter aortic valve implantation. Dapagliflozin appeared to confer greater relative benefit in patients with frailty.

items.summary_ja: DapaTAVI試験のpost hoc解析として、経カテーテル大動脈弁留置術（TAVI）後のダパグリフロジンの効果虚弱状態による差を調査した。ベースライン虚弱評価が得られた1222例中、虚弱47.2%、虚弱予備40.3%、健常12.4%であった。12ヶ月間で215例（17.6%）が主要エンドポイント（全死因死亡または心不全増悪の複合）を発現した。虚弱予備および虚弱患者は健常患者よりリスクが高く（調整HR 1.88 [95% CI 1.05-3.38]、2.29 [1.29-4.07]、P=0.004）、ダパグリフロジンは虚弱患者において主要エンドポイントのリスクを有意に低下させた（HR 0.53 [95% CI 0.36-0.77]）が、虚弱予備（HR 1.01 [95% CI 0.66-1.55]）および健常患者（HR 1.26 [95% CI 0.42-3.75]）では有意な効果は認められなかった（交互作用P=0.021）。虚弱はダパグリフロジンの安全性プロファイルを変調しなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: TAVI後の虚弱患者においてダパグリフロジンは主要エンドポイント（全死因死亡または心不全増悪）のリスクを有意に低下させ、虚弱状態による治療効果の差（交互作用P=0.021）が示された。
items.why_matters_ja: TAVI患者に虚弱は頻回であり、予後不良の独立した予測因子である。虚弱患者においてSGLT2阻害薬の相対的有益性が大きいことが示されたことで、TAVI後の個別化治療戦略の根拠となる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 無作為化比較試験（DapaTAVI試験）のpost hoc解析、多施設研究
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：1年時の全死因死亡または心不全増悪の複合
items.endpoint_results_ja: 12ヶ月間で215例（17.6%）が主要エンドポイントを発現。虚弱予備 vs 健常：調整HR 1.88（95% CI 1.05-3.38）。虚弱 vs 健常：調整HR 2.29（95% CI 1.29-4.07）。P=0.004。ダパグリフロジンによる虚弱患者のHR 0.53（95% CI 0.36-0.77）、虚弱予備患者のHR 1.01（95% CI 0.66-1.55）、健常患者のHR 1.26（95% CI 0.42-3.75）。交互作用P=0.021。
items.sample_size_ja: 1222例（ベースライン虚弱評価が得られた患者）

items.title: Obesity: oral therapy for those afraid of needles.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) pharmacotherapy has transformed obesity management, yet subcutaneous administration remains a barrier for patients with needle phobia. This review examines needle phobia and agoraphobia as contributors to treatment non-adherence and evaluates the evidence for oral GLP-1 RA alternatives.
AREAS COVERED: We synthesize evidence on the epidemiology of needle phobia (trypanophobia) and agoraphobia, their mechanisms and psychiatric comorbidities, real-world discontinuation rates of injectable GLP-1 RAs, and clinical efficacy data for oral semaglutide and emerging oral agents. A brief overview of the literature search methodology (PubMed/MEDLINE, Cochrane Library, ClinicalTrials.gov; searched to June 2026) is provided in the Introduction. A structured clinical decision algorithm is proposed.
EXPERT OPINION: Oral semaglutide 25 mg/day (the currently approved dose for weight management) demonstrates weight loss of similar magnitude to subcutaneous formulations across separate trials and should be considered preferentially in patients with moderate-to-severe needle phobia. Systematic needle phobia screening at obesity clinic entry, combined with a severity-based treatment algorithm integrating pharmacological and psychological approaches, is recommended to maximize equitable access to obesity pharmacotherapy.
items.authors: La Vignera Sandro, Condorelli Rosita A
items.summary_ja: 皮下注射GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）による肥満治療の変革を背景に、針恐怖症（trypanophobia）および広場恐怖症が治療非アドヒアランスに与える影響を考察し、経口GLP-1 RA（特に経口セマグルチド）の臨床的有効性に関する証拠を統合したレビュー。針恐怖症の疫学、機序、精神科的合併症、注射製剤GLP-1 RAのリアルワールドでの中止率、経口セマグルチドおよび新興経口製剤の臨床データを取り上げ、構造化された臨床判断アルゴリズムを提案している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 経口セマグルチド25 mg/日（現在承認されている体重管理用量）は、別々の試験において皮下注射製剤と同等の magnitude の体重減少を示しており、中等度〜重度の針恐怖症を有する患者では優先的に考慮すべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 皮下注射は針恐怖症患者にとって治療の障壁であり、治療非アドヒアランスの一因となっている。本レビューは、針恐怖症のスクリーニングと重症度に基づく治療アルゴリズム（薬物療法と心理的アプローチの統合）を提案することで、肥満薬物療法への公平なアクセスの最大化に寄与する。

items.title: A Retrospective Chart Review of Tirzepatide and Semaglutide Use in Prediabetes Management and Cardiometabolic Outcomes in a Rural Primary Care Setting.
items.abstract: Background: Prediabetes and obesity are highly prevalent conditions associated with increased risk of progression to type 2 diabetes (T2DM) and cardiovascular disease. While clinical trials demonstrate the efficacy of glucagon-like peptide-1 and dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide/glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, limited evidence exists in routine primary care, particularly in rural populations. Objective: This review aimed to examine associations between tirzepatide and semaglutide use and changes in glycemic status and cardiometabolic risk factors among rural-dwelling adults with prediabetes treated in a single rural primary care clinic. Methods: A retrospective chart review was conducted among 40 adults with prediabetes and overweight or obesity treated for 3-24 months with semaglutide or tirzepatide. Primary outcomes included body mass index (BMI) and hemoglobin (A1c). Secondary variables included blood pressure (BP), low-density lipoprotein (LDL), high-density lipoprotein (HDL), and triglycerides. Results: Significant improvements were observed in A1c, BMI, systolic and diastolic BP, LDL, and triglycerides (p < .001). All participants achieved normoglycemic A1c levels. No significant changes were observed in HDL levels. Conclusions: In this rural primary care setting, treatment with tirzepatide or semaglutide was associated with improvements in glycemic control and cardiometabolic risk factors. Findings should be interpreted cautiously due to the observational design and potential confounding factors. Implications for Nursing: Nurse practitioners are positioned to advocate for and implement pharmacological therapies for early management of prediabetes. Providers can drive meaningful changes in T2DM prevention and cardiometabolic health optimization.
items.authors: Holland Anna B, Andrabi Mudasir S, Appel Susan J, Walker Alan B
items.summary_ja: 農村部の一次医療クリニックで前糖尿病および過体重・肥満を有する40名の成人を対象に、セマグルチドまたはtirzepatideを3〜24か月間使用した際の血糖状態および心代謝リスク因子の変化を評価した後ろ向きカルテレビュー。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 農村部の一次医療環境において、tirzepatideまたはセマグルチドの投与は血糖コントロールおよび心代謝リスク因子の改善と関連し、全参加者が正常血糖域のHbA1cレベルを達成した。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬の有効性は臨床試験で示されているが、通常の一次医療、特に農村部住民における実証データは限られている。本研究は臨床試験外の実臨床環境での前糖尿病管理における薬剤使用の有用性を示す。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向きカルテレビュー（観察研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：BMI、HbA1c。二次変数：血圧（収縮期・拡張期）、LDL、HDL、トリグリセリド。
items.endpoint_results_ja: A1c、BMI、収縮期血圧、拡張期血圧、LDL、トリグリセリドに有意な改善が認められた（p < .001）。全参加者が正常血糖域のA1cレベルを達成。HDLレベルには有意な変化は認められなかった。

items.title: Clinical Feasibility of a Low-Dose Tirzepatide Strategy in Older Adults with Type 2 Diabetes: Persistence, Metabolic Benefit, and Treatment Simplification in a Real-World Cohort.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the clinical feasibility of a low-dose tirzepatide strategy in older adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus in routine outpatient practice.
METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort included Japanese adults who initiated tirzepatide between April 2024 and December 2025 and received a maximum observed dose of ≤5 mg/week through week 28. The primary endpoint in adults aged ≥65 years combined treatment persistence, absence of adverse event (AE)-related discontinuation, and either ≥3% weight loss or an HbA1c reduction ≥1.0 percentage point (≥11 mmol/mol). Younger adults were contextual comparators using overlap weighting.
RESULTS: Among 122 tirzepatide initiators, 107 were included in the low-dose strategy cohort, including 37 older adults. The primary endpoint was achieved by 23/37 (62.2%); 33/37 (89.2%) remained on treatment, and 2/37 (5.4%) discontinued because of AEs. Median body weight change was -3.07%, median HbA1c change was -1.0 percentage point (-11 mmol/mol), and 19/37 (51.4%) achieved HbA1c <7.0% (<53 mmol/mol). Renal, hydration, and nutritional laboratory markers remained generally stable. Overlap-weighted comparisons showed no clear age-related attenuation.
CONCLUSION: In selected older adults, low-dose tirzepatide provided modest metabolic benefit with high persistence and infrequent AE-related discontinuation.
items.journal: Endocrine practice : official journal of the American College of Endocrinology and the American Association of Clinical Endocrinologists
items.authors: Kanazawa Ken, Hayashi Koji, Xinyi Cao, Hijikata Mai, Kuwabara Koichiro
items.summary_ja: 2024年4月から2025年12月にチルゼパチドを開始した日本人成人を対象とした単一施設後ろ向きコホート研究。最大観察用量が週5 mg以下であった107例（うち65歳以上37例）を低用量戦略コホートとして解析し、治療継続率、有害事象による中止の欠如、および体重減少≥3%またはHbA1c低下≥1.0ポイント（≥11 mmol/mol）のいずれかを満たす複合一次エンドポイントを評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 65歳以上の選択された高齢者において、低用量チルゼパチド（≤5 mg/週）は高い治療継続率（89.2%）と有害事象による中止の低頻度（5.4%）を示し、一次エンドポイント達成率は62.2%であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 高齢T2DM患者におけるチルゼパチドの低用量戦略の臨床的実現可能性を実臨床データで示しており、治療簡素化と代謝的効果の両立が期待できる。
items.study_type_ja: 単一施設後ろ向きコホート研究

items.title: SGLT2 Inhibitor Therapy and Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With HFpEF and Type 2 Diabetes.
items.abstract: Background Atrial fibrillation (AF) frequently coexists with Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction, particularly in patients with Type 2 Diabetes, due to shared cardiometabolic and inflammatory mechanisms. Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) have demonstrated cardiovascular benefit in HFpEF, but data regarding prevention of incident AF remain limited. Objectives To evaluate the association between SGLT2 inhibitor therapy and incident atrial fibrillation/flutter in patients with HFpEF and diabetes mellitus. Methods We performed a retrospective propensity score-matched cohort study using the TriNetX Research Network. Adults aged ≥18 years with HFpEF and diabetes mellitus receiving oral antihyperglycemic therapy were identified. Patients receiving SGLT2 inhibitors were matched 1:1 with those receiving Dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors. The primary outcome was incident AF/flutter. Secondary outcomes included all-cause mortality, ischemic stroke, and composite major adverse cardiovascular events (cMACE; all-cause mortality, ischemic stroke, or acute myocardial infarction). Associations were assessed using hazard ratios (HRs) and risk ratios (RRs). Results After propensity matching, 37,108 patients were included (18,554 per group). Compared with DPP4 inhibitor therapy, SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with lower incidence of AF/flutter (17.8% vs 19.2%; HR 0.84, RR 0.93), all-cause mortality (12.5% vs 21.4%; HR 0.53, RR 0.59), ischemic stroke (7.4% vs 8.7%; HR 0.78, RR 0.85), and cMACE (24.4% vs 33.0%; HR 0.66, RR 0.74). Conclusions In patients with HFpEF and diabetes mellitus, SGLT2 inhibitor therapy was associated with lower rates of incident AF/flutter and adverse cardiovascular outcomes, supporting a potential role for SGLT2 inhibitors in modifying arrhythmic risk in addition to established cardiometabolic benefits.
items.authors: Acheampong Irene Animah, Blankson George, Kumi Dennis Danso, Tetteh Esther Bajo, Seidu Adama, Sullivan Claire, Zacharias Michael
items.summary_ja: HFpEFと2型糖尿病を有し経口降血糖薬を投与中の成人を対象に、TriNetX研究ネットワークを用いた後方視的プロパティスコアマッチングコホート研究を行った。SGLT2阻害薬群とDPP-4阻害薬群を1:1でマッチングし、新規心房細動/心房粗動の発生率を比較した。マッチング後37,108例（各群18,554例）が解析対象となった。SGLT2阻害薬群はDPP-4阻害薬群と比較して、新規AF/心房粗動（17.8% vs 19.2%）、全死因死亡（12.5% vs 21.4%）、虚血性脳卒中（7.4% vs 8.7%）、cMACE（24.4% vs 33.0%）の発生率が有意に低かった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: HFpEFと糖尿病を有する患者において、SGLT2阻害薬はDPP-4阻害薬と比較して新規心房細動/心房粗動の発生率を低下させ、心血管アウトカム改善と関連していた。
items.why_matters_ja: HFpEFと2型糖尿病を併せ持つ患者では心房細動が頻繁に共存し、共有される心代謝・炎症性メカニズムが関与している。SGLT2阻害薬はHFpEFにおける心血管有益性が示されているが、新規AF予防に関するデータは限られていた。本研究はSGLT2阻害薬が確立された心代謝効果に加え、不整脈リスクの修正にも寄与する可能性を示唆し、臨床実践におけるSGLT2阻害薬の適応拡大を支持する根拠となる。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的プロパティスコアマッチングコホート研究（TriNetX研究ネットワーク）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：新規心房細動/心房粗動（incident AF/flutter）。二次エンドポイント：全死因死亡、虚血性脳卒中、複合主要心血管不良事象（cMACE：全死因死亡、虚血性脳卒中、または急性心筋梗塞）。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 新規AF/心房粗動：SGLT2i群 17.8% vs DPP4i群 19.2%（HR 0.84, RR 0.93）。全死因死亡：SGLT2i群 12.5% vs DPP4i群 21.4%（HR 0.53, RR 0.59）。虚血性脳卒中：SGLT2i群 7.4% vs DPP4i群 8.7%（HR 0.78, RR 0.85）。cMACE：SGLT2i群 24.4% vs DPP4i群 33.0%（HR 0.66, RR 0.74）。

items.title: Advances in disease management and treatment outcomes for obesity and knee osteoarthritis in primary care practice.
items.abstract: The lifetime risk of developing knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is approximately doubled in people with obesity compared with those without obesity. Many patients with KOA are treated by primary care physicians in the community setting. We performed a targeted literature search on PubMed to identify relevant literature describing the impact of weight loss in patients with obesity and KOA. A strong body of evidence supports the use of weight loss through lifestyle interventions, including caloric restriction in combination with exercise, as a primary intervention in patients with KOA and obesity. Studies show that these interventions are associated with improvements in pain, physical function, and quality of life; however, adherence to lifestyle interventions can be challenging, even with individually tailored programs. Obesity medications, such as glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, are emerging as a new addition to weight management approaches in KOA, with a recent phase 3 clinical study demonstrating the benefits of semaglutide for weight loss in adults with KOA and high body mass index. Although initial data are promising, further clinical evidence is required, and perceived barriers to use need to be addressed before obesity medications can be widely adopted into clinical practice for patients with KOA. Specifically, further data are required to guide decisions regarding optimal treatment duration with obesity medications and to establish their tolerability profile associated with longer-term use. The importance of preserving functional muscle mass in patients with KOA and mitigation of weight regain after obesity medication treatment withdrawal are also identified as areas warranting further research. In this narrative review, we provide practical recommendations to primary care physicians on integrating obesity medications into weight-loss programs, including patient screening, risk stratification, communication, use of guidelines, and the benefits of a multidisciplinary approach.
items.authors: Nelson Amanda E, Callahan Leigh F, Schnitzer Thomas J, Batsis John A
items.summary_ja: 肥満と膝骨関節症（KOA）を有する患者における減量の影響について、PubMedを用いたターゲット文献検索に基づき実施されたナラティブレビュー。生活習慣介入（カロリー制限＋運動）の根拠、GLP-1受容体作動薬（セマグルチド）を含む肥満治療薬の登場、および一次医療における実践的推奨事項を概説している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満を伴うKOA患者では生活習慣介入による減量が疼痛・身体機能・QOLの改善に有効であることが強く支持されているが、アドヒアランスは困難であり、セマグルチドなどの肥満治療薬は有望な新規選択肢として登場しつつあるものの、広範な臨床導入にはさらなる臨床エビデンス（最適な治療期間、長期使用時の耐容性）が必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満を有する人のKOA発症の生涯リスクは約2倍に高まり、多くのKOA患者が一次医療で治療されている。本レビューは、一次医療医が肥満治療薬を減量プログラムに統合するための患者スクリーニング、リスク層別化、コミュニケーション、ガイドライン活用、多職種アプローチの利点など実践的推奨を提供する点で臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: ナラティブレビュー（PubMedによるターゲット文献検索に基づく）
items.endpoints_ja: 疼痛、身体機能、生活の質（QOL）、減量（セマグルチドのPhase 3試験における主要評価項目として言及）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Changes in Gait Speed During a 12-Month Multidisciplinary Obesity Management Program Including Semaglutide: A Real-World Observational Study in Japanese Adults With Musculoskeletal Disorders.
items.abstract: Background　Obesity is associated with musculoskeletal disorders, impaired mobility, and frailty. While semaglutide induces substantial weight loss, its effects on objectively measured physical function in routine clinical practice are unclear. We investigated the changes in gait speed and physical function during a multidisciplinary obesity management program that included semaglutide.Methods　This retrospective observational study included 22 adults with obesity and musculoskeletal disorders who completed a 12-month multidisciplinary obesity management program. The program included nutritional counseling every two months, physical therapist-guided exercise intervention, and semaglutide treatment. The primary outcome was the usual gait speed. The secondary outcomes included body weight, pain score, step count, muscle function, and body composition.Results　Body weight decreased significantly from 89.2±18.6 kg to 81.5±17.3 kg (p<0.001). Usual gait speed improved significantly from 0.77±0.20 m/s to 0.91±0.19 m/s (p<0.001). Pain scores also significantly improved (p<0.001). Improvements in gait speed were not associated with weight loss (r=0.22, p=0.32) or pain reduction (r=-0.04, p=0.84). Baseline gait speed was inversely associated with gait speed improvement (r=-0.44, p=0.043), indicating greater gains in participants with poorer baseline mobility.Conclusions　A 12-month multidisciplinary obesity management program, including semaglutide, significantly improved gait speed in patients with obesity and musculoskeletal disorders. Greater improvements were observed in participants with impaired baseline mobility. These findings support the evaluation of obesity treatment not only by weight loss, but also by recovery of mobility.
items.authors: Tomita Masuomi, Harashima Fumiya, Takeda Naoto, Ishida Chikako, Nagasaki Kazuhito, Kikuchi Kyota, Hisamichi Katsuya
items.summary_ja: 肥満と筋骨格系疾患を有する22名の成人を対象に、セマグルチドを含む12ヶ月の多職種肥満管理プログラム（2ヶ月ごとの栄養カウンセリング、理学療法士指導による運動介入、セマグルチド治療）における歩行速度と身体機能の変化を後ろ向き観察研究で検討した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドを含む12ヶ月の多職種肥満管理プログラムは、肥満と筋骨格系疾患を有する患者の歩行速度を有意に改善し、ベースライン時の移動機能が低い参加者ほど改善が大きいことが示された。歩行速度の改善は体重減少や疼痛軽減とは関連しなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満治療の評価を体重減少のみならず、移動機能の回復という観点からも行うことの重要性を支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き観察研究
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：通常歩行速度。副次エンドポイント：体重、疼痛スコア、歩数、筋機能、体組成。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 体重：89.2±18.6 kg → 81.5±17.3 kg（p<0.001）。通常歩行速度：0.77±0.20 m/s → 0.91±0.19 m/s（p<0.001）。疼痛スコア：有意に改善（p<0.001）。歩行速度の改善は体重減少（r=0.22, p=0.32）および疼痛軽減（r=-0.04, p=0.84）とは関連しなかった。ベースライン歩行速度は歩行速度の改善と逆相関（r=-0.44, p=0.043）。歩数、筋機能、体組成の結果は抄録に記載なし。

items.title: Outcomes in patients with diabetes, atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, and heart failure treated with tirzepatide or dulaglutide: SURPASS-CVOT analysis.
items.abstract:
AIMS: The impact of tirzepatide and dulaglutide on major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and heart failure (HF) outcomes according to HF status is unknown.
METHODS AND RESULTS: Patients with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease were treated with tirzepatide up to 15 mg or dulaglutide 1.5 mg weekly (average 4 years). The incidence of MACE-3 [cardiovascular (CV) death, myocardial infarction (MI), stroke], MACE-4 (CV death, MI, stroke, coronary revascularization) and composite of all-cause or CV death and hospitalization or urgent visits for HF were analysed in patients with and without a history of HF. A history of HF (20.3%) was associated with more coronary artery disease and prior MI. Incidences of event categories were higher in the HF group. The hazard ratio (HR) for all-cause death or hospitalization or urgent visits for HF on tirzepatide vs. dulaglutide was 0.83 [95% confidence interval (CI) 0.70-0.99] in patients with HF and 0.88 (95%CI 0.78-1.00) without HF. The HR for CV death or hospitalization or urgent visits for HF was 0.85 (95%CI 0.70-1.03) and 0.96 (95%CI 0.83-1.12), for MACE-3 0.90 (95%CI 0.76-1.08) and 0.93 (95%CI 0.83-1.04), and for MACE-4 0.81 (95%CI 0.69-0.95) and 0.91 (95%CI 0.83-1.00) in patients with and without HF, respectively. The patient-reported outcomes of APPADL and EQ-5D-5L visual analogue scores improved and were higher on tirzepatide in both groups.
CONCLUSION: With overall non-inferiority established, this exploratory analysis revealed lower rates of the composite of all-cause death or HF events, or MACE-4 among patients with T2D and HF treated with tirzepatide compared with dulaglutide.
items.authors: Nicholls Stephen J, Pavo Imre, Bhatt Deepak L, Buse John B, Del Prato Stefano, Franco Denise R, Kahn Steven E, Lincoff A Michael
items.summary_ja: SURPASS-CVOT試験の探索的解析として、2型糖尿病（T2D）かつ動脈硬化性心血管疾患（ASCVD）を有する患者において、tirzepatide（最大15 mg）またはdulaglutide（1.5 mg）を週1回投与（平均4年間）し、心不全（HF）有病歴の有無別にMACE-3、MACE-4、および全死因または心血管死とHFによる入院・緊急受診の複合エンドポイントの発生率を比較した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: T2DかつHFを有する患者において、tirzepatideはdulaglutideと比較して全死因死またはHFイベントの複合エンドポイント（HR 0.83, 95% CI 0.70-0.99）およびMACE-4（HR 0.81, 95% CI 0.69-0.95）の発生率が低かった。
items.why_matters_ja: T2Dかつ既知のHFを有する高リスク集団において、tirzepatideがdulaglutideに対して心血管および心不全アウトカムで優越性を示唆する探索的エビデンスを提供し、GLP-1 RA/GIP RA複合体のHFに対する追加的有益性を示す点で臨床的に意義がある。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（SURPASS-CVOT）の探索的事後解析
items.endpoints_ja: MACE-3（心血管死、心筋梗塞、脳卒中）、MACE-4（心血管死、心筋梗塞、脳卒中、冠動脈再血管化）、全死因または心血管死とHFによる入院・緊急受診の複合エンドポイント、患者報告アウトカム（APPADL、EQ-5D-5L VAS）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 全死因死またはHFによる入院・緊急受診の複合：HFあり HR 0.83（95% CI 0.70-0.99）、HFなし HR 0.88（95% CI 0.78-1.00）。心血管死またはHFによる入院・緊急受診の複合：HFあり HR 0.85（95% CI 0.70-1.03）、HFなし HR 0.96（95% CI 0.83-1.12）。MACE-3：HFあり HR 0.90（95% CI 0.76-1.08）、HFなし HR 0.93（95% CI 0.83-1.04）。MACE-4：HFあり HR 0.81（95% CI 0.69-0.95）、HFなし HR 0.91（95% CI 0.83-1.00）。APPADLおよびEQ-5D-5L VASは両群でtirzepatide群が改善し高値であった（具体的数値は記載なし）。

items.title: Cost-effectiveness of Empagliflozin in Chronic Heart Failure: A Markov Model-based Analysis in Uzbekistan.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Chronic Heart Failure (CHF) is a major public health challenge associated with high morbidity, mortality, and healthcare costs. Empagliflozin has demonstrated clinical benefits across the spectrum of heart failure; however, evidence on its economic value in low- and middle-income countries remains limited. To evaluate the cost-effectiveness of adding empagliflozin to standard therapy for patients with chronic heart failure from the perspective of the healthcare payer.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A cohort-based Markov model with a 3-month cycle length and a 20- year time horizon was developed to simulate disease progression in CHF. Health states included no complications, cardiovascular complications, renal complications, and death. Outcomes were measured in Life Years (LYs), Quality-Adjusted Life Years (QALYs), total costs, and Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratios (ICERs). Both deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analyses were conducted.
RESULTS: Quality-adjusted life expectancy increased from 11.595 to 12.224 QALYs. Total discounted costs were 48,133,588 UZS for empagliflozin versus 43,261,361 UZS for standard therapy. The Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio (ICER) was 7,738,951 UZS per QALY gained, which was substantially below the national willingness-to-pay threshold of 141.6 million UZS.
DISCUSSIONS: Since the ICER for empagliflozin compared with placebo is substantially lower than the calculated willingness-to-pay threshold, empagliflozin can be considered a costeffective treatment option.
CONCLUSIONS: Adding empagliflozin to standard therapy for CHF is a cost-effective intervention in the Republic of Uzbekistan and provides meaningful clinical and economic benefits.
items.authors: Sultanbayeva Nargiza, Umarova Shakhnoz, Iskandarova Shokhista, Mullabaeva Guzal, Mukhamedova Shohista
items.summary_ja: ウズベキスタンにおける慢性心不全患者に対する標準療法へのエンパグリフロジンの追加投与の費用対効果を評価するため、コホートベースのMarkovモデル（3ヶ月サイクル、20年ホライズン）を用いた分析を行った。健康状態は合併症なし、心血管合併症、腎合併症、死亡の4状態を想定し、決定論的および確率的感度分析を実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: エンパグリフロジンのICERは7,738,951 UZS/QALYであり、国内のWTP閾値（141.6百万UZS）を大きく下回っており、ウズベキスタンにおいて費用対効果のある治療選択肢と判断された。
items.why_matters_ja: 低・中所得国におけるエンパグリフロジンの経済的価値に関するエビデンスが限られていた中、ウズベキスタンの医療保険者視点での費用対効果を定量的に示し、同国における治療方針決定に資する。
items.study_type_ja: Markovモデルに基づく費用対効果分析（薬物経済学モデル）
items.endpoints_ja: QALYs、総コスト、ICER
items.endpoint_results_ja: QALYs: 11.595 → 12.224、総割引コスト: エンパグリフロジン群 48,133,588 UZS vs 標準療法群 43,261,361 UZS、ICER: 7,738,951 UZS/QALY

items.title: Real-World Treatment Patterns and Weight Outcomes Before and After a Tirzepatide Price Increase in Over One Million Self-Paying UK Adults With Overweight or Obesity.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist-based medicines are highly effective treatments for overweight and obesity, but population-scale real-world evidence remains limited, particularly in self-funded settings where treatment choice may be influenced by relative price. We aimed to characterise provider reach and treatment patterns through a large United Kingdom (UK) telehealth provider, assess changes around the September 2025 tirzepatide list-price increase of up to 170%, and estimate longitudinal weight trajectories.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective cohort study of adults initiating semaglutide or tirzepatide through MedExpress from 1 May 2024 to 1 January 2026 was conducted. Treatment initiation and switching were analysed using segmented interrupted time-series models, with sensitivity analyses addressing anticipatory changes in August 2025. Weight trajectories were estimated using linear mixed-effects models.
RESULTS: Among 1 033 522 adults, 932 659 (90.2%) initiated tirzepatide and 100 863 (9.8%) semaglutide; provider reach was higher among women than men. In September 2025, semaglutide initiation increased by 31.15 percentage points (95% CI: 26.07-36.24) relative to the projected pre-interruption trend. Tirzepatide-to-semaglutide switching increased by 9.26 percentage points (95% CI: 7.09-11.42) and subsequently attenuated. Sensitivity analyses supported anticipatory changes in August. At 12 months, estimated weight loss was 19.93% with tirzepatide (95% CI: 19.88-19.98; n = 30 763) and 16.40% with semaglutide (95% CI: 16.16-16.64; n = 979).
CONCLUSIONS: A single UK telehealth provider achieved substantial reach among adults with overweight or obesity. Treatment initiation and switching changed markedly around the tirzepatide price increase. Substantial longitudinal weight loss was observed among patients contributing follow-up in the context of limited adjunctive lifestyle support.
items.authors: Dix Sophie, Mulligan Anna, Ficarelli Mattia, Brooke Edward, Rosenior-Patten Onayomi, Chen Simon, Maybury Catriona, Bray Benjamin D
items.summary_ja: 英国のテレヘルスプロバイダー（MedExpress）を通じて2024年5月1日から2026年1月1日にsemaglutideまたはtirzepatideを開始した成人を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。2025年9月のtirzepatideのリスト価格最大170%値上げ前後の治療パターンの変化をsegmented interrupted time-seriesモデルで解析し、線形混合効果モデルで体重推移を推定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: tirzepatide価格上昇後、semaglutideの開始は予測トレンド比で31.15ポイント増加し、tirzepatideからsemaglutideへのスイッチは9.26ポイント増加した。12ヶ月時の体重減少はtirzepatide群で19.93%、semaglutide群で16.40%と推定された。
items.why_matters_ja: 自己負担（self-funded）環境におけるGLP-1受容体アゴニストのpopulation-scaleな実世界エビデンスは限られており、価格変動が治療選択に与える影響と、補助的な生活習慣支援が限定的な環境下での実世界における体重減少の規模を示す点で意義がある。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的コホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: 1) semaglutideとtirzepatideの治療開始パターン（2025年9月価格上昇前後の変化） 2) tirzepatideからsemaglutideへのスイッチ率の変化 3) 12ヶ月時の体重減少率
